articleTitle: Intelligent Agriculture Greenhouse Environment Monitoring System Based on IOT Technology
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In recent years, greenhouse technology in agriculture is to automation, information technology direction with the IOT (Internet of Things) technology rapid development and wide application. This paper takes CC2530 chip as the core, presents the design and implementation of agriculture Greenhouse Environment monitoring system based on ZigBee technology, the wireless sensor and control nodes takes CC2530F256 as core to control the environment data. This system is made up of front-end data acquisition, data processing, data transmission and data reception. The ambient temperature is real-time processed by the temperature sensor of data terminal node. Processed data is send to the intermediate node through a wireless network. Intermediate node aggregates all data, and then sends the data to the PC through a serial port, at the same time, staff may view, analysis and storage the data by the PC that provide real-time data for agricultural greenhouse, fans and other temperature control equipment, and achieve automatic temperature control.

articleTitle: Smart City, Smart Transportation: Recommendations of the Logistics Platform Construction
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Smart transportation is one aspect of the smart city. Because the low efficiency, the transportation has became the second largest industry of carbon emissions. It's not only affect the smart transportation, but also affect the smart environment. So, improve the efficiency of the transportation is very important to the smart transportation and smart city. The logistics platform is a new business model, which can be improve the un-load rate and decrease the carbon emissions. But, the logistics platforms are at the early development. How to build is a very important issue. This paper has given three suggestions to it. Firstly, to clarify the roles what you will to be, secondly, to choose the model of the platform which fit for your company, thirdly, using an iterative development model to design the product.

articleTitle: A Coverage Algorithm for WSN Based on the Improved PSO
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: An optimized coverage algorithm based on the improved PSO is put forward targeted at the issue of coverage and energy consumption in the data-collection-oriented wireless sensor network (WSN). Through improving the valid position of the PSO's computational nodes, the work nodes covering the monitoring zone are chosen according to the network coverage quality to be properly moved. The simulation experiment suggestions that the algorithm can meet the network coverage requirement with fewer worknodes, reduce the dead zone, efficiently cut the overall network energy consumption and lengthen the network lifetime.

articleTitle: A New Theory of Reactive Power Control of Grid Connected PV Inverter
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of solar energy and other renewable energy, PV grid connected power generation technology has more and more attention. Grid connected inverter is the core of grid connected power system. When grid connected inverter operated in grid, the current control mode is essentially a voltage source input and current source output of the inverter. At present, a lot of work has been carried out in the aspects of filter selection, grid connected control strategy and controller design in the domestic and abroad, aiming to improve the power quality of grid connected current. In this paper, the reactive voltage control strategy of grid connected photovoltaic system is studied in order to increase the penetration rate and improve the stability of grid voltage. Grid connected PV system generally consists of a number of inverters, so it is necessary to analyze the control strategy of a single inverter and the reactive power output constraints.

articleTitle: Network Traffic Prediction Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Predicting and modeling network traffic is always an important subject in network capability studying. The aim of this article is to explore a new network model in order to describe and predict the network character accurately. Firstly wavelet neural network is investigated and its disadvantages are analyzed. In order to overcome disadvantages of wavelet neural network, genetic algorithm is used to optimize weight and threshold of neural network. At last, the proposed algorithm is used in network traffic prediction and the results show the proposed scheme has good performance.

articleTitle: Research on Bus Roll Stability Control Based on LQR
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Based on the analysis of the bus system dynamics, the five degrees of freedom bus system dynamics equation has been established, using vehicle speed and front wheel angle as input, and sideslip angle, yaw rate, the sprung mass roll angle, the sprung mass roll angular speed, lateral load transfer capacity front axle and rear lateral load transfer capacity as output. According to the linear control theory, the design of LQR control system has been optimized. The established bus active roll control simulation model and the root locus analysis can help to determine the vehicle stability system. The buses roll stability control can be achieved by simulation.

articleTitle: E-Commerce Personalized Recommendation System Based on Web Mining Technology Design and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The current e-commerce site users are rapidly increasing, through the realization of the personalized recommendation service to help users convenient and efficient shopping process, become each big e-commerce site, effective way to improve service efficiency. Personalized recommendation system based on Web data mining technology good achieved this goal, and shows the Web mining technology the use of the advantages in the field of electronic commerce. This paper mainly expounds the e-commerce personalized recommence system design process and implementation process.

articleTitle: Image Encryption Technology Research Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Digital image parallel encryption structure based on cellular neural network is proposed to improve the efficiency and security, where the properties of parallel computing and local diffusion of cellular neural network are utilized effectively. A kind of group encryption algorithm based on feistel framework is put forward. In each round, a cell encrypts one block image data with block encryption algorithm firstly, and then affected by the output of 8-neighbouring cells. Then the image encryption algorithm is effectively strengthened by raius basis chaos neural network. The experiment results show the proposed algorithm has good effect.

articleTitle: An English POS Tagging Approach Based on Maximum Entropy
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper adopts the maximum model for English part of speech tagging. It makes pre-tagging for the word that has the only part of speech during the pretreatment of corpus, which adds many context features that can be utilized. We also improve the tagging algorithm, and take into account the whole optimization of POS series without extra computation, and the accuracy of tagging is also improved. The experimental results show the accuracy of open test has much room of improvement. The experimental results show that the combined algorithm achieves 94% accuracy and recall rate, and fully integrates the advantages of the maximum entropy method, which can be compared with the results of the same training and test corpus in ideal state.

articleTitle: Voice Activity Detection Based on the Improved Dual-Threshold Method
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Voice activity detection of speech signal is an important part in the process of speech recognition. The accuracy of voice activity detection is directly related to the accuracy of speech recognition. In this paper, the use of locomotive voice as test data, using the traditional dual-threshold method for voice activity detection. It is found that under the quiet and noisy conditions the traditional dual-threshold method obtained information of speech voice activity detection having lots of errors. In view of the above problems, this paper presented an improved dual-threshold method to make voice activity detection, processing speech signal, short-time average energy and zero crossing rate. And through MATLAB simulation, the experimental results show that under the quiet and noisy conditions comparing the improved method proposed by this paper and the traditional method, are closer to real speech voice activity part in the test data.

Author Keywords: Dual-threshold Voice activity detection Short-term energy Short-term zero rate

articleTitle: Research on Equipment Predictive Maintenance Strategy Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: As costs in equipment maintenance have been more and more expensive, equipment maintenance management is of great importance in equipment management in recent years. Firstly, cost of the equipment predictive maintenance model is proposed, which fully utilizes the big data technology. Particularly, the best maintenance cycle and maintenance times can be obtained exploiting the mutual game of the cost model based on the big data technology. Secondly, a novel equipment predictive maintenance method is proposed using general regression neural network, which is able to mine the relationship of data in a specific time series. Thirdly, four types of equipments are utilized in the experiment, including: 1)Dump truck, 2)Wheel loader, 3)Numerical control machine, and 4)Metal cutting machine. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed general regression neural network based equipment predictive maintenance algorithm is able to predict maintenance cost accurately.

articleTitle: An Improved Indoor Positioning Method Based on Received Signal Strengths
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: With the economy developing rapidly, Location Based Service (LBS) has attracted more and more people's attention. Indoor positioning methods based on WLAN and RSS with advantage of low cost are most widely used. In this paper, we propose an improved indoor positioning method based on received signal strength to obtain better accuracy. We apply selected weighed K nearest neighbor (WSKNN) to get a better initial point of the gradient-descent-based location search (GLS) which is combined with exhaustive location search (ELS) to achieve a better result. Experimental results conducted in the real environments show that our proposed algorithm can obtain improvement of the mean error distance of 7.17% and 22.54%, compared with the GLS-CF method and traditional KNN method, respectively.

articleTitle: A Review and Analysis of Case-Based Reasoning Research
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Case-Based Reasoning (CBR) is an approach to problem solving by reusing and if necessary adapting the solutions to similar problems that were solved in the past. In this article we review a representative selection of CBR research in the past few decades on aspects of retrieval, reuse, revision, and retention. Our analysis clarifies some common misconceptions about CBR research and proposes a set of future research directions.

articleTitle: An Improved Collaborative Filtering Similarity Model Based on Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: At present, collaborative filtering has already become one of the most widely used means to provide personalized recommendation service. The crux of collaborative filtering is to utilize user-rating-data matrix for the sake of figuring out similar neighbor users or items with similar ratings, which can be realized mainly by virtue of similarity algorithms. Recommendation consequences which are gained though the traditional algorithms, like Pearson correlation coefficient, cosine and so forth, might not be satisfactory, especially in the context of comparatively sparse user-rating-data matrix. The thesis based on the improved similarity algorithms proposed by relevant researchers, analyses the shortcomings of the pre-existing algorithms, redefines the similarity algorithm formulas including the concept of weight, and furthermore makes use of the characteristics of neural network to practice in order to the optimal weight. This thesis designs an experiment on the foundation of two real data sets, comparing the recommendation effects between the newly-built similarity algorithm models and the pre-existing ones. The results indicate that the superiority of the new method in different parameter circumstances.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection Algorithm Based on Improved Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet and information technology, detecting network intrusion behaviors have been attracted more and more attentions. In this paper, we proposed a novel network intrusion detection algorithm using a hybrid ant colony and support vector machine model. Main ideas of SVM are that it denotes a representation of the examples as points in space, and examples of the separate categories are separated by a gap. Afterwards, framework of the detecting network intrusion system is given, which is designed to promote the accuracy of detecting network intrusion by optimizing parameters of support vector machine with ant colony algorithm. Finally, four types of network attack behaviors are utilized in this experiment, that is, a) DOS, b) R2L, c) U2R, and d) Probe. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method is able to detect network intrusion with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Cryospheric Changes in the Tibetan Plateau and Its Effects on Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The core glaciers of China or even the whole Asia are centered on the Tibetan Plateau. The Tibetan plateau also holds one of the world's most major permafrost areas in high altitude regions. In recent decades, global warming, mainly caused by anthropogenic activities, has deteriorated the conditions in the Tibetan Plateau. The glacier and snow covering in the Tibetan Plateau have been shrinking at a comprehensive and accelerating rate and the permafrost is degenerating. The ecological degradation and significant hydrological changes in river, lake, swamps and wetland in the Tibetan Plateau are closely related to the cryosphere changes. This paper reviews the research on the covering changes of glacier, permafrost and snow across the Tibetan Plateau over the last few decades. For example, according to Chinese glacier inventory statistic, the glacier has decreased from 41, 119 in 1970 to 40, 963 in 2008, the monitoring sites along Tibetan highway illustrated that permafrost with temperature lower than -3°C has mainly warmed without severe degradation but permafrost areas with temperatures higher than -1°C have receded, According to Environmental and Ecological Science Data Center in the west of China, the area of accumulated snow is expanding gradually but the annually snow-covered area is shrinking continuously during 2003-2010. On the other hand, emphases were placed on a discussion of the relationship between cryosphere and ecosystem and investigation of its profound influence.

articleTitle: Certificateless Anonymous User Authentication Protocol for Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Recently, many user authentication schemes for cloud computing have been proposed. However, most of the proposed schemes have security flows and high computation costs. In this paper, a securely efficient cloud computing user authentication protocol is proposed, which is based on certificateless cryptology scheme without bilinear pairings to minimize the authentication time. Moreover, user anonymity service is achieved via a temporary identity (TID) provided by ID provider, instead of user's true identity. Additional replay protection from an attacker is included in the authentication phase to prevent a possible replay attack. Compared with the related works, the proposed scheme has higher security levels, which is more practical in cloud computing environment.

articleTitle: Cloud Accounting: The Transition of Accounting Information Model in the Big Data Background
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Cloud Accounting is an online accounting information system based on cloud computing and customer use the computer or other devices to achieve accounting and financial analysis functions. The development and popularization of "cloud" computing may have a great impact on corporate accounting information application and building model, which will provide favorable conditions for the development of SMEs. Based on the author's work and learning experiences, this paper first analyzed the accounting data processing issues under the background of big data, Then, on this basis, the paper proposed the cloud model building strategy under the background of big data, where the author made a profound analysis for the cloud model, Finally, the article proposed the cloud accounting application countermeasures in the big data background.

articleTitle: Research on Traffic State Evaluation Method for Urban Road
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: An effective traffic state evaluation method is very important to obtain the behaviors of road traffic system. In this paper, the traffic state is divided into six categories, and the traffic state evaluation is considered as a classification problem. Then, vehicle velocity is chosen to be the evaluation index from the point of traffic managers. Based on those, a novel method integrating the subjectivity of the velocity data and the objectivity of the traffic participants is proposed to evaluate the traffic state, and its effectiveness is verified with real traffic data experiments.

articleTitle: The Key Technology Research of Quality and Safety Traceability Systems of Agricultural Products
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In recent years, as the security incidents about agricultural product have frequently occurred at home and abroad, there has been widely attention to the issue of the quality and safety of agricultural product. To solve problem of the quality and safety of agricultural product, establishing the traceability of agricultural systems become more urgent and important. This paper presents a general framework and designs of the main functions of the system, analyzing the key techniques of system functions. The system takes the technology of RFID, environment monitoring, geographic information, bar code, coupled with data transmission and computer technology. The system not only allows consumers to learn more about agricultural products, but also for production management and quality control of agricultural products provides a good platform.

Author Keywords: Quality and Safety of Agricultural product

articleTitle: The Research of the Enterprise Financial Model Based on Information Entropy and Correlation Model Reorganization Theory
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: On the basis of comprehensive analysis of the traditional evaluation method, this paper proposes a financial competitiveness evaluation model combining the entropy weight method and grey correlation theory, better overcome the incompleteness and uncertainty of information, and reveal the implicit relationship between the sample indicators, provides a practical and feasible method to analyze and evaluate enterprise financial competitiveness. Enterprise core competitiveness theory is put forward to provide a new perspective to examine the opponent and evaluation for the enterprise operator.

articleTitle: Application of Electronic Nose Technology in the Detection of Wheat Quality
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In this paper, an electronic nose system was designed to detect wheat qualitative change quickly, this system mainly includes three parts: sampling system, data collection, signal processing and analysis. By detecting gas species released by the wheat in storage, the system can determine whether the has wheat qualitative changed, and the level of wheat qualitative change can be discriminated by the gas concentration. After using PCA and improved BP algorithm to experimental data processing, the experimental results shows that the system can rapidly and accurately detect wheat qualitative change and the degree of that. Finally, The author made a prospect on the application of electronic nose technology in wheat detection.

articleTitle: Research on Job Security Scheduling Strategy in Cloud Computing Model
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper concentrates on the problem of job security scheduling problem under the cloud computing environment. The Architecture of the cloud computing platform is made up of four layers, including 1) SOA architecture, 2) Management Middleware, 3) Resource virtualization and 4) Physical Resources. Next, we formally describe the problem of the job security scheduling under cloud computing. To guarantee the security level of job scheduling, security demand and trust level are defined in our work. Afterwards, the proposed genetic algorithm based job security scheduling is proposed. The main innovation of our proposed algorithm lies in that we utilize each chromosome to represent a schedule of a set of jobs on several computers, and then each gene is represented as a pair to describe the relationships between jobs and computers. Finally, experimental results demonstrate that our algorithm can effectively schedule jobs with higher level security and lower processing time cost.

articleTitle: A Bandgap Reference and Over Temperature Protection Circuit Designed for TCXO Chip
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This article designed a bandgap voltage reference source with a low temperature drift, high power supply rejection ratio for the TCXO chips , and design the sensitive reaction of thermal protection circuit is used to protect TCXO chips. The structure of self-biased current source and differential operational amplifier is used in the bandgap reference, And the over temperature protection circuit controlled oscillator on or off by a NPN transistor to detection the circuit current.The simulation results show that the range of the voltage output is not more than 0.78 mV when the temperature changes at -40 to 125, The power supply rejection ratio in the circuit is as high as 95dB; the oscillator is turned off When the temperature is greater than 150 degrees,and it's restart when the temperature is less than 130 degrees, and it turn off needs less than 0.071 S, restart needs less than 0.064 S. The circuit can provide a stable reference and good temperature protection effect, which has great practical value for the TCXO chip.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Discussion on the Application of Big Data in Urban Residents Travel Guidance
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper discusses the application of big data in the residents travel guidance system. The system is based on traffic service information platform and tries to make the information collection and analysis system suitable for more types of data through applying the big data with characteristics of volume, variety, velocity. The application of big data processing technology in this system will form a complete transportation guidance system with the big data, geographic information system and the cloud storage. The big data processing technology will be used to simplify the program of residents travel guidance and raise the quality of urban traffic information.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of the Smart Home Control System Based on the Bluetooth
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper adopts the air cleaner as the carrier to design and realize an smart home control system plan based on the Bluetooth. Compared with the traditional home control system, the system plan can provide convenient operation status monitoring, internal data processing, information feedback, short-distance wireless control. In this paper, AT89C51 SCM (single chip microcomputer) is adopted as the core processor, and the corresponding hardware circuit is designed. Based on the programming of the circuit, various functional modules are realized. The operation logic of various functional modules is expounded in great details. Design results suggest that the system plan is stable and convenient in operation, reasonable in structure and strong in mobility, so it is suitable for ordinary household application. Besides, the research findings of this paper can provide some references for the further study, popularity and promotion of the smart home control system.

articleTitle: Optimal Control for Region of the City Traffic Signal Based on Selective Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Through the analysis for the current urban road network and the urban traffic control schemes, establish the model of the average of vehicle up-time in road network. Then, by use for reference thinking of natural selection of genetic algorithm improved the minimum value problem of particle swarm optimization algorithm. Hereafter, the model was optimized by the improved particle swarm optimization, and the solving result when the model is the minimum value is the optimal timing scheme of each intersection within the region. Finally, collecting traffic information through the regional road network consisting of four-way intersection near the school, and this data as the basis to build a four-way intersection area network in VISSIM5.20 software, and making simulation experiment of the comparison of the optimization model and traditional timing scheme by MATLAB software. The results of the analysis according to the simulation experimental shows that the average running time of all vehicle of region increase about 24.1 percent, and the average delay time of all Intersection reduce about 27.4 percent. In a certain extent, Improve the efficiency of regional transit traffic and ease urban traffic pressure, and has some applicability.

articleTitle: BP Neural Network Optimization Model Based on Nonlinear Function Transformation Approach
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Regular harmony search algorithm has defects such as prematureness and convergence stagnation when treating complicated optimization problems, which influence on optimizing the performance of BP neural network. For function optimization problems, we analyze two key parameters of HS algorithm: harmony fine adjustment probability and the harmony adjustment range, which affect the performance in searching. Then we propose a dynamic method based on the adaptive change of PAR and BW. The improved HS algorithm is integrated with BP neural network to optimize the network weight. The simulation results show that in the optimization, the algorithm proposed in this paper is better than basic HS and other improved HS algorithms. IT reduce the network error obviously and speeds up the convergence rate.

articleTitle: Scheduling Optimization Model and Algorithm Design for Two-Way Marshalling Train
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Train operation adjustment is a kind of real-time multi-objective large scale combination optimization problem with multi-restriction. A novel immune genetic algorithm based on artificial immune algorithm and genetic algorithm is put forward. Then scheduling optimization model for two-way marshalling train is proposed, which is solved by the proposed immune genetic algorithm. Finally, an instance based on the two way marshalling train is constructed. The simulation results show the feasibility of the model and the algorithm.

articleTitle: Regional Voltage Stability Prediction Based on Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Because of the imperfection of the theory concerning the regional dynamic and static voltage stability evaluation problem and insufficient reliability of the history data retrieved from the FTU, a novel pattern-recognition based algorithm is proposed. The proposed algorithm utilizes advantage of the decision tree algorithm and a decision tree algorithm model was built for the purpose of evaluation of voltage stability status of the regional power grid. Three feature has been extracted for the recognition of the instability pattern. The training set and the test set data are both obtained from simulation data and outputs. By using the proposed method on IEEE 39-bus system and the predefined critical unstable situations, we obtained the decision tree algorithm model on the IEEE 39-bus system stability prediction model. After the simulation, the output data are compared with the original stability status. The experiment comparison shows that the decision tree algorithm model has achieved the acceptable accuracy for the assessment of voltage stability prediction of the regional power grid. The validity of the proposed assessment scheme as well as the adaptability and the accuracy of the classification model are verified by simulation results of IEEE 39-bus system.

articleTitle: Design of Combined Substation Monitoring System Based on ATT7022B and RS-485
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: A combined substation monitoring system based on ATT7022B and RS-485 was designed in this article. The monitor terminal communicates with each other in a cascading fashion through RS-485 bus. The data about electrical parameters and switching value were collected to send to the monitoring center in order to realize the function of remote control and collect meter reading. Also, the article shows the design of anti-interference, software on communication and PC interface design. The method of clock calibration is designed to ensure the accuracy of event record processing, charge accounting and so on. The test results indicate that the system is stable, accurate and has a high application value.

articleTitle: The Study of Teacher Feedback and Student Responses in English Classroom Interaction
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper first analyzes the necessity of practical English practical education in China, and then establishes the AHP analysis model to study the practical education of English in China. It is found that the positive interaction between teachers and students, the positive construction of students' interest, and the construction of positive communication and learning environment are the important strategies to implement practical English education in China. Then the game theory is made on the relationship between teachers and students. Finally, this paper obtained the relationship between teachers and students in English classroom interaction.

articleTitle: Research on Colour and Texture Feature Based Image Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper focuses on the content-based image retrieval technique, and mainly from the perspective of image color, texture feature extraction and feature matching, explores: 1 using a variety of improved color histogram and gray level co-occurrence matrix based on the retrieval means, so as to lessen the shortage of information space of the traditional color feature extraction and to improve the efficiency of the retrieval system, 2 the relations between information of different feature, hence proposing the normalized algorithm of internal and external features to integrate different retrieval methods effectively.

articleTitle: Campus Employment Information Network Development Based on Android Platform
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In recent years, with the development of mobile communication technology, mobile phone transmission speed is more and more faster and the smartphones are indispensable communication equipment of students. Based on powerful information processing ability and extensible ability of the smart phone, as well as the 3G high-speed data transmission, more and more functions are developed and have large-scale applications. Android mobile phones have occupied most of the mobile phone market, so demanded functions can be realized in mobile terminals. The study is based on Android platform, taking Java programming language as the auxiliary. Through the construction of mobile phone SQ Lite database, the server controller is created to implement the employment information management system, which effectively promotes the university graduates employment and realizes sharing of resources.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Finance Business Risk Evaluation Scheme Based on Fuzzy Theory
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: As a relatively new research field, the current literature research on supply chain financial risk management mostly focuses on the concept and qualitative description of value. In the aspect of theoretical research, a theory system on supply chain financial risk comprehensive management has not been formed. In the aspect of practical application, scientific quantitative measure model tools and effective risk management techniques and methods are scanty. Because of this, based on the era and realistic background of current supply chain finance development, according to the inherent requirement and the research logic of comprehensive risk management, this paper systematically and deeply studies supply chain financial risk management, and builds a theoretical model framework of supply chain financial risk management, which can provide theoretical guidance. We find a quantitative risk monitoring model, which is suitable for supply chain financial risk measure requirements. It introduces a kind of new idea and new method of modern risk management which conforms to financial risk prevention and control reality of supply chain.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-vehicle Scheduling Problem Based on Dynamic Demand
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: After analyzing the dynamic vehicle scheduling problem (DVSP), the DVSP is transformed into the static vehicle scheduling problem (SVSP) at different times of the time axis, and the dynamic demand of the DVSP model is established. A quantum inspired evolutionary algorithm based on DVSP is designed, and the two phase decoding strategy of "first line grouping" is used to construct the quantum chromosome, and the crossover operator is designed by using the genetic code of two 0. Finally, the algorithm is verified and analyzed. The results show that the algorithm has better convergence ability, convergence speed and high efficiency.

articleTitle: A Novel Coal Mine Security Monitoring System Based on ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The paper puts forward a novel coal mine management system to solve the real-time monitoring and highly efficient rescue problems of underground work platforms. The scheme of ZigBee wireless sensor network combined with Controller Area Network (CAN) bus is adopted in this system. ZigBee substation is set at proper intervals in mine laneways to acquire Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) position and gas thickness. And then the information is packed and uploaded to monitoring center by CAN bus. At last it could be processed, saved and displayed in mode of chart show. The system has the functions of miner orientation, attendance management and security monitoring. It can be replanted in other application domains.

articleTitle: Construction Engineering Project Quality Evaluation Method Based on Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper focuses on the problem of construction engineering project quality evaluation, which is of great importance in modern construction engineering project management. At first, a construction engineering project quality evaluation index system is provided, which contains five parts: 1) Construction engineering project quality evaluation, 2) Structural engineering, 3) Masonry engineering, 4) Decoration Engineering, and 5) Installation engineering. Afterwards, a construction engineering project quality evaluation method is proposed. Next, to test the effectiveness of the proposed method, experiments are conducted using ten samples which are collected from real construction engineering projects. Experimental results provide very positive results.

articleTitle: The Application of Hierarchical Clustering Based Logistic Regression Classification Algorithm in Coal Area
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In coal analysis, there exists high dimensional feature information in the dataset. However, there are several irrelative or redundant features. Feature selection algorithm could select the relative attributes, but it is possible that some important features are deleted. In this paper, we propose hierarchical clustering based logistic regression algorithm. It firstly selects multiple groups of features using random selection, and builds multiple models. After model built, it clusters the models and makes the similar models into one clustering. Finally, we use the logistic regression clustering to complete the forecast work for future dataset.

articleTitle: Path Planning Efficiency Maximization for Ball-Picking Robot Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper aims to find a ball-picking optimal path and drives the robots to collect all the tennis in the shortest time, according to the optimal path. Thus, the work to be completed for us includes: establish agent model for robot working environment in tennis yard, analyze the advantage and shortcoming of ACO and provide an improved ACO. Our scheme improves the pheromone updating strategy. The global and local updates are integrated to strength the pheromone strength of optimal ant. Then we add the crossover and mutation operation of GA to speed the convergence of algorithm. By the simulation results analysis we find that the improved ACO has stronger optimizing ability and stability, which further improves the performance of ball-picking path.

articleTitle: Proof of the Template of the Image Relief Effect
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: As a result of the relief image surface pattern shapes are often very complicated, no rules of geometry and detailed, with traditional computer graphics methods is difficult to achieve realistic embossed reproduction effect and the practical processing effect. At present, there are few new theoretical achievements in this field in China. This paper designed a simple method to get the 3D relief effect fast, color images based on cellular neural networks (CNN) embossment effect processing method, through simulation experiment, this method has proved its convenient operation and implementation, and its application in the hail cloud layer image pre-processing, achieved good results.

articleTitle: Data Aggregation Protocols for Wireless Sensor Networks Based on ACO
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In this article, we expanded analysis for the constructing of data convergence protocol through ant colony optimization. First, we introduced the ant colony optimization, the basic structure of wireless sensor network and data gathering process. Secondly, in the experimental simulation part, ACO system model was constructed on this structure based on the structure of wireless sensor network. Finally we found a way to solve the optimal solution for data aggregation by using the artificial ant colony algorithm. Ant System model simplified the creation of data aggregation protocol, and made the complex network structure become more clarity.

articleTitle: An Applied Research in the Rural Landscape of Rainwater Collection System Based on the Concept of LID
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The target of villages rainwater harvesting is to trap impermeable pavement and prevent rainwater runoff, and rainwater accumulated is mainly used for domestic miscellaneous water, environmental and ecological water. Low Impact Development (LID) is an analog of natural storm water management. The rainwater collection system, which is based on the concept of LID storm water control, is easy to operate and inexpensive. According to the characteristics of village rainwater harvesting, towns rainwater collection system will be divided into five parts: roof rainwater harvesting, courtyard rainwater harvesting, street rainwater harvesting, green rainwater harvesting and landscape rainwater storage pond. We summarize the principles of rainwater collection systems in towns and villages landscape applications: low-impact, low-maintenance, low-cost, design with nature, design to life, the overall planning, collaborative implementation. Provide reference for the ecological and circular village rainwater resource utilization.

articleTitle: The Evaluation Studies of Regional Transportation Accessibility Based on Intelligent Transportation System: Take the Example in Yunnan Province of China
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The transportation accessibility greatly represents and influences the regional social economic development. This study is based on the concept of intelligent transportation system which adopts the transportation distance range, transportation accessibility time and accessibility coefficient to be the quantitative evaluation index of intelligent transportation. By taking the example in Yunnan Province, we evaluated the regional transportation accessibility. This study uncovers that the transportation accessibility is obviously different among regions. At the end, the paper has proposed relevant solutions to existing problems.

articleTitle: Recognition of the Hail Image Based on Distance Discriminant
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Meteorological disaster is one of the major natural disasters in the world, the hail is one of the types of meteorological disasters, the affected area is broad, big loss rate and other characteristics, as the current research hot spot. This paper, by using weather radar reflectivity echo intensity of the image, to extract the characteristics of the hail cloud image data, Analysis of hail cloud images and the hail cloud image characteristics of the differences between data, Using the first-order statistics measure as a distance criterion variables, tectonic discriminant model. To take advantage of this model for samples, known hail cloud recognition rate is 90%, and discriminant has low error rate. The results show that the use of weather radar reflectivity echo intensity of the image of the first-order statistics measure combined with distance discriminant constructs discriminant model of hail cloud, has a good effect.

articleTitle: Design of Human Capability Maturity Analysis System Online P-CMM Model
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Along with the intensifying market competition, the growth of small and medium-sized private enterprises will mainly rely on the unique competitiveness which was gave birth by efficient management system and the institution system. This paper references the approach of people capability maturity model (P-CMM) in the performance management, and introduces the general mode of P-CMM and the methods of performance management in P-CMM, then learns other theories and methods of performance management. Performance-based management is essential for the development of SMEs. At last, it designs the model of performance management system which is fit for private SMEs in our country.

articleTitle: The Research of Encryption Algorithm for Voice Communication of Mobile Station
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The safe problem of mobile communication attracts more and more attention in recent years. In this paper, key technologies for encryption communication of mobile station are studied and an efficient scheme of encryption communication of mobile phone is proposed. An encryption algorithm of anti-RPE-LTP coding is then presented to realize safe end-to-end communication for mobile phone.

articleTitle: The Research of Photovoltaic Micro-inverter and a Design of Flyback Type Photovoltaic Micro-inverter
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: At present, due to over-exploitation and utilization of non-renewable resources such as fossil fuels, the energy crisis has become a worldwide problem. In this context, the inexhaustible solar received more and more attention. Photovoltaic is one of the main formal uses of solar energy. This paper expounds the advantages of micro-inverter systems and analyzes the design requirements of micro-inverter. This paper focus on the Module Integrated fly back Converter and make a design of it, the principal research concentrates on the topology of the main circuit, When the fly back converter works, it acts as both the role of the inductor to store energy, but also to achieve voltage conversion and electrical isolation. Duo to the parasitic of the oscillation of the leakage induction and switch, transformers, etc. The voltage of the drain-source will spikes high, which makes the switch voltage and current stress increase and large loss of the circuit.

articleTitle: The Simulation Research of Automobile ABS System Based on Fuzzy Theory
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Through the analysis of fuzzy control theory, automobile ABS system basic fuzzy control strategy is designed, the process and basic thought of fuzzy controller design is discussed in detail. At last, we use Matlab/Simulink software to analysis the all model, and the result show that, the controller of this paper designed has good control effect.

articleTitle: Information under the Network Environment Using Computer Information Security Technology
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Build a security of computer information network environment, the use of computer information processing technology is very important. In the current information security technology to improve environment, enhance the computer network users understanding of computer information security technology is very necessary. This article first elaborated under the network environment, the necessity of computer information security technology, then further analyze the actual process of information security technology to meet various problems, and puts forward practical wider related computer information security technology, to enhance the general computer user information security awareness to provide certain reference basis.

articleTitle: Bus Scheduling Feasibility Study of Rainy Day Based on the Mobile Phone Signal Data
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The organization of rainy day traffic flow will appear a certain confusion especially in moderate rain or more rainfall, causing a large number of bus passengers gathered at bus stops. By means of the data acquisition and analysis of the site passenger cell phone signal, we can match the sites where having more passengers with bus lines. The bus dispatching department can conduct temporary scheduling to reduce crowding bus stops. This article firstly introduces the main characteristic of mobile technology and mobile phone signal data, and puts forward the phone signaling data of the passengers on bus stations in rainy day, providing the reference suggestion for the bus temporary scheduling. Finally, we analyze the feasibility of bus dispatching using mobile phone signaling data on rainy days.

articleTitle: Design a Real-Time Client of WebGIS Based on HTML5
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The rapid development and application of computer network has encouraged the application of GIS which is popular in a wide range and made the research of Web GIS be a focus. There are some problems about the browser of Web GIS. For example, the drawing efficiency is poor, it cannot support vector drawing directly and so on. In order to improve the client's interactivity and real-time performance, This article is on the basis of solving those problems that browser doesn't support vector drawing and rendering slowing, little storage place and the slowing transfer rate, combined with the HTML5 Canvas, Web Socket, Web Storage technology to build a Web GIS real-time client that could improve those problems effectively and help changing users' feelings.

articleTitle: An English Part of Speech Tagging Method Based on Maximum Entropy
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: As part of speech is a fundamental step in syntactic parsing and machine translation, this paper proposes an English part of speech tagging method based on maximum entropy, and this issue is very crucial for natural language processing. The proposed part of speech tagging system is made up of two steps, that is, (a) Training process and (b) Tagging process. Maximum Entropy estimation is able to compute Probability Density Function of the random variables, and in this paper, we solve the problem of tagging part of speech for English by tackling an optimization problem using maximum entropy. Using the ISO-639-1 code: EN dataset, a series of experiments are conducted. Finally, experimental results prove that the proposed method is very effective to tag part of speech for English.

articleTitle: Realizing High-Speed PBKDF2 Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Message verification is important for information security, and the hash-based algorithm is a kind of implementation method. In this paper, we propose a circuit implementation scheme to realize message verification, which is based on SHA1, called HMAC-SHA1. In our scheme, the MD5 circuit module is reusable such that the circuit size is reduced and the processing speed is improved. Finally, we use VeriIog HDL to picture the circuit structure and implant it into FPGA to do experiments.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Genetic Algorithm Optimized Neural Network Controller
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The selection of neuron number in hidden layer of RBF neural network is key point in RBF network training. Unreasonable selection of center point and long training time are also usual problems in RBF network. Since the time efficiency can be lowered to improve network performance for basic genetic algorithms, the schemes have subjectivity and lower convergence rate. Then this paper proposes a new RBF neural network learning method based on improved adaptive genetic algorithm. It introduces optimal retention mechanism, adaptive intersection probability and sequence comparison to overcome the precocity, which improve the convergence rate and accuracy of network. It can also get the optimal solution of RBF neural network controller for global searching weight, to acquire an ideal controlling effect.

articleTitle: An AHP Based Evaluation Model for Agricultural Production and Marketing Docking
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In order to make the government guidance of the production and marketing docking of agriculture market more effective, an evaluation system of the production and marketing docking should be built by employing Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). In this paper, three primary indexes and eleven secondary indicators was selected to build the evaluation system based on the weighted average method. In the empirical study part, we simulated three authorities for agricultural products management to test the established model. The results showed that the model works well in calculating the evaluation values of the docking effect and sorting results.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Distance Education Platform Based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper studies the design and implementation technology of the distance education platform based on virtual reality technology as well as the design for the system and structure of distance education platform based on virtual reality technology, which consists of three such subsystems as the virtual learning community, the simulation laboratory and the digital teaching places.

articleTitle: The Gradation Test Prediction Model of SMA-16 Modified Asphalt Mixture
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Correlation models of fractal volume parameters and fractal dimension of SMA-16 modified asphalt mixture are established. The volume parameters of SMA-16 modified asphalt mixture can be predicted by the known fractal dimension, which is advantageous to the grading test, so as to determine the structure type of asphalt mixture. Thereby the workload can be reduced and the design efficiency can be improved.

articleTitle: Generalized Predictive Control Based on Complex Systems Adaptive
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In the actual industrial production process, the system of the controlled object often there's a lot of uncertainty due to some reason, for this kind of system, the traditional method is difficult to follow the change of model parameters in real time. Based on this, this paper presents a complex system of adaptive ladder type of generalized predictive control scheme by using controlled system to cat clustering method of fuzzy identification structure and identifying model set the ladder (multiple model adaptive generalized predictive control scheme), to solve the uncertainty of the system, then for each performance index of the sampling time of switching the choice of optimal controller was realized, and at the same time in order to realize the system global optimal control, and design the ladder type of generalized predictive controller, the final design simulation experiment to validate, the results show that the model has unique advantages compared to other methods.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis and Trajectory Tracking Control of Articulated Heavy Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Articulated heavy vehicles have heavy loads, high shipping efficiency and low mileage cost. But due to the interaction between the tractor and the trailer, it is easy to appear "jack-knifing" or "trailer sway" and it is difficult to follow the given path of the travel. To this end, a four degrees of freedom single track model of a tractor/full-trailer is built, and the stability analysis is carried on to study the influences of the structural and operating parameters on the vehicle. Furthermore the trajectory tracking controller of trailer is designed, which can ensure that the trajectory of the trailer follows that of the tractor exactly by the control of the active front wheel steering angle of the trailer and the vehicle can maintain good handling stability.

articleTitle: An Improved Video Monitoring System Based on RSVP Protocol
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In order to improve the quality of signal transmission in video surveillance system based on IP network, the method to configure resource reservation protocol (RSVP) on the video stream link node is proposed, which can reserve bandwidth for the video stream transmission, and then can guarantee the effective transmission of video signal. Through an example, the method of RSVP deployment and the running mode after deployment are introduced, and the simulation experiments are carried out with Opnet. The results show that the RSVP protocol can effectively reduce the time delay of the data packets in the video surveillance system, and can meet the needs of real-time video monitoring system.

articleTitle: Discussion on Energy Saving Technology and Energy Saving Way of Green Building
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In this paper, the necessities of the green building energy saving technology developed is analyzed in detail, and understand the impact of the green building energy saving technology developed for the future development of the country and the people. Then the construction of green building energy saving technology system is analyzed, and the problems in the process of building energy saving technology system of green building are analyzed, and the main construction direction of green building energy saving technology system is obtained.

articleTitle: Research of Fractal Artistic Graphics Generation Method
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Graphic color which is obtained from traditional escape time algorithm is very single and it cannot effectively reflect structural characteristics of M set and J set so image cannot be effectively applied in generalized scope. This paper introduces genetic algorithm and integrates user preferences into genetic process by adding human-computer interaction in order to reflect designers' design ideas. Meanwhile, it solves difficult expression of fitness function in conceptual design and adopts adaptive method to guarantee optimal property in genetic population. Then, above methods are applied in genetic algorithm-based fractal pattern drawing system and the effectiveness of above methods is verified through actual cases.

articleTitle: Study on Long-Term Operation Stability of Fiber Optical Current Transformer Based on Faraday Effect
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The long-term operation stability of fiber optical current transformer (FOCT) is a concern, with its wide use in smart grid. The FOCT long-term operation stability is related to whether FOCT can accurately measure the current in the smart grid, which affect the performance of the related equipment. In this paper, the long-term operation stability test results of the FOCTs in an 110kV smart substation will be an example to analyze the long-term operation stability problems, such as ratio error and phase error. And then the treatments can be proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Fault of an 110kV Independent Electronic Current Transformer
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Electronic current transformer (ECT) is widely used in smart grid, especially intelligent substation. However, fault is unavoidable for ECT in long term operation. In this paper, the fault of an 110kV independent ECT based on low-power current transformer is an example to analyze the reasons for the fault via reasonable analyzing methods and proposed the corresponding treatments.

articleTitle: The Research of English Teaching Pattern under Multimedia Technology
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: With advances in computer, uses multimedia technology more widely, Based on English teaching multimedia technology to achieve under the multimedia courseware and teaching CD-ROM design, foreign Original Movie, music teaching, multimedia audiovisual said platform, and the establishment of delivery class secondary structure analysis, the main factor to enhance the quality of teaching, improve learning efficiency, to stimulate interest in learning, curriculum resources sharing as a guide. In the modeling process, consider the characteristics of multimedia teaching English teaching objectives, curriculum and student characteristics cognitive level.

articleTitle: Implementation and Application of Web Data Mining Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The current database and artificial intelligence are hot topics in the study of data mining technology, this paper stands in the basis of concept and key technology of cloud computing, Web data mining technology of cloud computing methods, the method to realize the mining technology accordingly.

articleTitle: Intelligence Evaluating System of Lift Balancing Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Based on designing the solving algorithm of balancing coefficient, the application system of lift balancing coefficient automatic drawing and printing was develop by using C#.net programming language. On this application system, the graphic chart can be output quickly and accurately by computer. Therefore, the expert can judge the movement status of the lift easily and quickly.

articleTitle: Study on Case-Based Reasoning-Inspired Approaches to Machine-Learning
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This commentary briefly reviews work on the application of case-based reasoning (CBR) to the design and construction of machine-learning approaches and computer-based teaching systems. The CBR cognitive model is at the core of constructivist learning approaches such as Goal-Based Scenarios and Learning by Design. Case libraries can play roles as intelligent resources while learning and frameworks for articulating one understands. More recently, CBR techniques have been applied to design and construction of simulation-based learning systems and serious games. The main ideas of CBR are explained and pointers to relevant references are provided, both for finished work and on-going research.

articleTitle: Dynamic Optimization of Engine Connecting Rod
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: To lightweight the engine connecting rod, and ensure it to meet the performance requirements, static equivalent load method was studied in the paper. Firstly, connecting rod stress distribution was analyzed. Then, multi-body dynamics model was established for the transient analysis, and connecting rod maximum stress was gotten when the engine working. Finally, using equivalent static load method, the dynamic load was converted to an equivalent static load. And as the boundary conditions, it was used to the optimization process to optimize the shape of connecting rod. The weight of lightweight connecting rod was reduced by 9.5%. Under the condition of satisfying the stress, the purpose of the connecting rod optimization was reached.

articleTitle: Based on Cellular Neural Network with Fisher Discriminant Method of Hail Forecast
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Using Cellular Neural Network edge detection to the image of hail and non hail get the features of extraction edge of the image, get the main feature of image. Two-dimensional wavelet transform for edge detection, get the four discriminant features of each image, With feature data analysis the difference of hail and non hail image, Using the Fisher discriminant method to construct the discriminant model, Select the xinjiang region of radar chart analysis. Results show that the method used in this article can be a clear distinguish hail and non hail, and the discriminant error is small, with good results.

articleTitle: Based on Multi-objective Fuzzy Decision Model to Study Tech Micro Enterprise Financing Credit Risk Evaluation System
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper based on fuzzy clustering model to rank scores is used to evaluate high-tech small and micro enterprises financing credit risk. According to the index weight of the resulting weight value, analyzing the impact results. Determine level indicators include high-tech small and micro enterprise financing characteristics, operational risk, credit risk, financial services risk, legal and reputation risk, and refined based on level indicators of secondary indicators, finally get fuzzy evaluation results.

articleTitle: Effect of Gradation of Mineral Admixtures on Chloride Permeability of Concrete
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: We researched the permeability of different mix proportion. We compared the grading curve of the optimal grading by theoretical calculation (including aggregate and gelled material) and there mixture ratio of test. And we compared the permeability of different mixture ratio. We draws the following conclusions: Permeability of concrete with long age has close relationship with gradation including aggregate and gelled material. Dosage of mineral admixtures has no big effect on permeability, while the proportion of different mineral admixture has big. The limestone powder content had the greatest influence to permeability by gradation, so increasing its content instead part of cement within certain range could increase the ability of permeability resistance.

articleTitle: Key Technology Analysis and Application Research of Accounting Informationization under Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The study of this paper begins form the promotion function of cloud computing to enterprise accounting informationization and introduces the principle and features of cloud computing that influence the development of enterprise in national economy. We further propose an application model for accounting informationization under cloud environment and compare it to traditional models. This paper tries to establish cloud-selected framework and studies the selection on suitable cloud services. It introduces related technologies like big data and cloud computing to design platform and establish the system with the aspect of data acquisition, storage, analysis and implementation flow. So the knowledge of accounting big data can be mined, utilized and shared. Meantime, we set corresponding safety mechanism to ensure the integrity of data safety to achieve the value of accounting information system.

articleTitle: College Student Management System Design Using Computer Aided System
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In this paper, we propose a design for college student management system utilizing computer aided system, which can play an important role in college management. Firstly, we organize our proposed college student management system via a hierarchical structure, which contains (1) Web display layer, (2) Business logic layer, (3) Data access layer, and (4) Database layer. Secondly, ER diagram of the college student management system is described, and several elements are included in it, such as teacher information, department information, major information, class information, student information, course information, manager, employment information, comprehensive score and course type. Thirdly, functional module design for college student management system is provided, in which three types of users are designed in this system, that is, students, teachers and managers.

articleTitle: Based on Goal Programming Model of Optimization Study of Dyeing and Finishing Technology
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: With the development of our country economy from high to medium speed, the textile industry in China has gradually entered the period of adjustment of a transformation and upgrading, in the process of the development. The textile industry is facing unprecedented opportunities, difficulties and challenges. Also it caused the textile industry to dyeing and finishing technology of attention. In this paper, according to the technology and capital investment in the textile industry in China, the paper draws the conclusion that the different quality requirements of the factory can arrange the input and output of the dyeing and finishing technology, which will not result in the waste of technology, capital and raw materials, but also guarantee the quality. Bring economic benefits to the manufacturer, the optimal configuration of the dyeing and finishing process. At the same time, China's textile industry will be able to develop fast and good, dyeing and finishing technology can be more advanced, the production quality is more assured.

articleTitle: Based on the Cross-Cultural Perspective of the Change of English Teaching Research in China
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Today in the rapid development of information technology, multimedia technology, more and more used in the field of education, has caused the literature education teaching reform. Based on English cross-cultural characteristics of teaching content, teaching by multimedia technology made the courseware for teaching activities. The spread of English as a language for cultural, has its own characteristics, we must according to its characteristic, based on the language of the ontology, adhering to the "nature", "literariness", "discipline" three major principles, the production of the courseware and design, to show the characteristics of literature as a discipline, and to achieve the effect of its service in the teaching, so as to promote English teaching reform, a comprehensive and in-depth and development.

Author Keywords: Cross-culture English language teaching Research of transformation

articleTitle: Traffic Influence of Road Traffic Fire Based on VISSIM
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: With the development of social economic and increasing of vehicle, car fires occur frequently. It not only brings huge losses of life and property, but also disturbs urban traffic operation, thus brings bad impact on urban transportation that in turn influences the rescue efficiency. In this paper, the characteristics of traffic fire and traffic influence of fire are discussed at first, and then simulation experiments on traffic operation before and after fires are conducted using VISSIM software. The test results show that the fire accident will bring big delays and long queue length to upstream traffic flow but the influence will be significantly reduced after taking some reasonable traffic restrictions.

articleTitle: Research on the Comprehensive Evaluation of Sports Management System with Analytical Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Analytical Hierarchy Process is applied in sports research, and it makes it possible to carry out quantitative analysis and qualitative analysis in the research. This paper tries to use the Analytic Hierarchy Process in system engineering to carry on the comprehensive evaluation of sports management system and to seek a method of simple calculation and relatively objective evaluation. The judgment of the relative importance of various factors at each level is being used to express the judgment and constituted a judgment matrix. The study makes a comprehensive evaluation of Sports management System with Analytical Hierarchy Process, and puts forward a method for relative objective and quantitative evaluation, and provides a basis for the decision maker.

articleTitle: Network Traffic Prediction Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Predicting the network traffic flow for large-scale network can significantly improve the quality of service security, and this problem has been attracted more and more researches. In this paper, we study on forecast network traffic by a hybrid Flexible neural tree and Particle swarm optimization model. Framework of the particle swarm optimization based network traffic forecasting is made up of three steps: 1) Obtaining network flow data, 2) Constructing the network flow and 3) Building a flexible neural tree to implement the network traffic prediction system. As flexible neural tree based network traffic prediction is greatly influence by parameters selection, We utilize particle swarm optimization to optimize parameters for the proposed algorithm. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can effectively forecast network traffic with lower error rate.

articleTitle: Critical Value Estimate of Corn Moisture Diffusion Activation Energy Based on the Temperature and Humidity Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Temperature, humidity and weight sensors were used collecting corn ear of temperature, humidity and weight value in order to calculate the corn moisture content in the experiment of natural ventilation drying. Average moisture diffusion coefficients were calculated by using Parts' equation of the moisture, temperature and the diffusion coefficient established to estimate the moisture diffusion activation energy of corn ear in four barns. The results showed that diffusion coefficient apparently tend to rise with temperature increasing. Different barn shape had a great influence on diffusion coefficient. Temperature could accelerate the evaporation of moisture and improve the drying rate of corn. As the changes of temperature, moisture diffusion activation energy, water molecule diffusion needed the smaller energy with the increase of temperature and the water molecule was easy for freedom from the restraint.

articleTitle: Based on the Mat Lab Image Enhancing Technology and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The Matlab image processing tool system is the tool of the current commonly used digital image processing, development and use in the digital image increasingly wide range of circumstances, with the method of image enhancing technique prominent part image is becoming more and more widely used. This article introduces the characteristics and advantages and disadvantages of the Matlab image processing system, this paper mainly introduces the main way of digital image acquisition and processing, and expounds in detail the implementation process of the Matlab image enhancing technique.

articleTitle: Scheduling and Implementation of Network Product Logistics Supply Chain under the Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Network Product Logistics Supply Chain Scheduling focused on operations research in the study of queuing theory, scheduling theory, supply chain coordination mechanism, operational research in transportation issues, and conduct research on game theory. Evolutionary algorithm is an effective way to get the optimal solution, evolutionary algorithm based on the solution of the original problem to improve, so that after solving a set of optimized solutions, from a given set of initial solution is started, first in this initial set Solutions judge, then be screened in the initial solution in iterative solution as the basis for later, and then again repeat the operation until all the nodes have to meet the requirements after stopping.
