Logistics supply chain scheduling problem is to solve the problem of optimal to give the program the best solution based on the evolution of the logistics supply chain scheduling model, making the scheduling process to achieve cost savings, speed and other effects.

articleTitle: The Construction of Fabric Grading Model Based on SOM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In the traditional textile field, the mechanization automation has been popularized, the enterprise is faced with the challenge of the consumer to the fabric quality. With the rapid development of computer, the application of artificial intelligence in fabric grading is more and more widely. This paper is based on the SOM algorithm to construct the evaluation model of the fabric. It can improve the efficiency of the complex type. To provide a reliable mathematical model and verification for the screening of fabrics in the textile industry and enterprises to improve their efficiency.

Author Keywords: Fabric grading Mathematical model Artificial intelligence

articleTitle: Building Supply Chain Logistics Assessment System That Maximize Efficiency by Coefficient of Variation
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In this article, evaluation index system was constructed based on logistics capability by AHP method and coefficient of variation. Principle analysis about the supply chain logistics was carried out. The system can be used as reference of assessing supply chain logistics revenue. First of all, looking for the best performance of the supply chain logistics efficiency index between logistics and supply chain logistics capability, mode of action, mechanism of action, the core content by AHP method. That is the logistics capability of supply chain logistics. Secondly, in the experimental simulation part, weights about capacity of logistics elements and logistics operation were calculated by coefficient of variation. Logistics capability will be eventually as an evaluation index of supply chain logistics assessment system that maximize efficiency.

articleTitle: Wavelet Neural Network in the Design and Application of Hydrological Forecast
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: With the continuous development of national economy, water resources has become more and more an important part of social and economic development, the research of water resources related issues has vital practical significance. Combining the theory of wavelet and neural network to their advantages, based on the theory of wavelet neural network prediction model is established, using the nonlinear simulation ability of the wavelet neural network reservoir prediction research of annual runoff, good simulation and prediction results have been achieved.

articleTitle: Fiber Bragg Grating Spectrum Analysis Based on Intelligent Computing
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In view of the problems encountered in the process of analyzing fiber grating feature, in order to reduce the amount of data calculation as well as acquire characteristics information of fiber Bragg grating reflection spectrum rapidly and accurately, we put forward the improved scheme based on particle swarm optimization algorithm. The identified fiber Bragg grating reflection spectrum characteristic information amount is used to represent fiber grating sensing. Fiber Bragg grating uniform axial force is used as an example to verify that the algorithm is suitable in the fiber Bragg grating reflection spectrum analysis, which also has advantages of high stability and good accuracy.

articleTitle: Geotechnical Material Properties and Testing under Reliability Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Through reliability analysis method to study the geotechnical material properties and testing, theoretical analysis was expand based on the formation of geotechnical materials, the concept of geotechnical engineering analysis and reliability analysis method. Feasibility analysis was unfold by using fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to study combine computer technology, electronic measurement technology, optical measurement technology, test technology, remote sensing technology with geotechnical feature detection. On this basis, the study of reliability was developed through reliability analysis. The results explained that it was feasible that combined computer technology, electronic measurement technology, optical measurement technology, remote sensing and Testing Technology with detection of geotechnical material properties. And computer technology had the highest credibility.

articleTitle: Wavelet Algorithm in the Analysis and Prediction of Hydrology and Water Resources in the Practice Application
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: With the rapid development of modern applied mathematics and computer technology, artificial intelligence is used to calculate theory and analysis method can greatly promote system analysis techniques and information analysis and calculation of water science research and development. In this paper, drawing on a variety of new theory and analysis techniques, on the basis of analyzing the complex Morlet wavelet transform characteristics of time domain and frequency domain analysis, wavelet transform is studied in the process of scale factor and shift factor the influence of frequency resolution for fashion, from the Angle of the Parseval theorem and convolution theorem is deduced respectively on the quick and practical calculation method of the orthogonal wavelet transform coefficient, provides the complex Morlet wavelet cycle recognition algorithm.

articleTitle: Remote Medical Care Monitoring System Design and Implementation Based on Computer Network
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The paper analyses the development of wireless remote medical monitoring system and designs a model for the remote medical monitoring system. The system has five parts, which respectively are physiological monitor terminals, smart mobile terminals, IOCP-based network communication server, database, monitoring center software and client. Physiological monitor terminals collect physiological data and send it to smart mobile through wireless communication network. The smart mobile terminal analyses and sends the physiological data to the monitoring center by TD-SCDMA or Wi-Fi. The doctor and the patient's family can carry out real-time monitoring on patient's health by remote medical care monitoring system.

articleTitle: Design of Cloud Safety Monitoring Management Platform of Saline Alkali Industry
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper describes the necessity of construction of cloud computing platform of saline alkali industry. Through the demand analysis of saline alkali industry on public technology service, Cloud Safety Emergency Rescue Command Management System of saline alkali industry are designed as the core application, saline alkali industry services, science and technology industrial park management are designed as auxiliary application, all kinds of enterprises' production systems needed to work on the cloud architecture, thus forming the public technology service cloud platform based on the safety regulation.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Measured Wave Data around Toumen Island Sea Area in Taizhou
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The statistical analysis of short wave data about B1 and B2 wave measure station around Toumen Island in Taizhou sea area showed that: the normal and strong wave direction are between east to southeast, the big wave is mainly impact by typhoon, annual average significant wave height is less than 0.7 m, and the frequency of annual average wave period great than 7s is 0.6%, matching the wave spectral by standard spectral, the relative wave parameter P is 1.53 for B1 station, and 1.75 for B2 station.

articleTitle: Image Retrieval Method Based on an Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: To retrieval images we required with high effectiveness and accuracy, in this paper, we study on how to implement an effective image retrieval system using particle swarm optimization. Firstly, framework of the Particle Swarm Optimization based image retrieval system is described, which is able to integrate three image visual features (such as Bag of visual words feature, Color feature, Texture feature) together by an improved particle swarm optimization. Secondly, we modify the standard PSO algorithm by describing the position and velocity of each particle in a multiple dimensional binary solution space and a continuous space. Afterwards, several most similar images with highest ranking scores for each testing image are obtained by our algorithm. Finally, experimental results show that using the Corel1K and Corel5K dataset, our proposed algorithm can effectively promote the Precision, Recall and F-measure in the image retrieval system.

articleTitle: Analysis Technology of Data Mining Technology and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: At present, the technology of data mining and analysis of practical stronger and stronger, the connotation of analyzing large data mining technology, characteristics, and according to the characteristics of classification is a series of challenging projects. Hardtop cloud computing can be used in large data mining platform system architecture is analyzed, the paper will be of HDFS and graphs processing technology is introduced in detail.

articleTitle: Study on Finite Element Numerical Simulation of Shallow Buried Tunnel Based on Displacement Back Analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In order to more precisely to acquire the mechanics parameter of surrounding rock for finite element modeling, on the basis of a tunnel of Longlin~Baise expressway in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, the method of acquiring the mechanics parameter of surrounding rock based on displacement analysis was applied. According to the field measurement raw data, the equivalent elastic modulus and lateral pressure coefficient was acquired by means of the displacement back analysis program, as BMP90.In the finite element modeling analysis, the equivalent elastic modulus and lateral pressure coefficient and parameters suggested from related standard was applied. Compared the calculation results and the field measurement raw data, and it shows that the calculated results based on the back analysis is more consistent with the field measurement raw data, and the surrounding rock parameters based on the displacement back analysis is more coincide with the real engineering. The study can provide certain reference for selection of mechanics parameters of surrounding rock.

articleTitle: Study on the Coupling Relationship between Land Use and Economic Development and the Corresponding Optimization Path
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Under the background of economic development, the thesis arranged analysis and studies for the overall development status of Kunming. The study selected data about economic development and land use of Kunming in the year from 2002 to 2011 and applied linear regression method to perform further quantitative research for the mutual relations between them. The findings of the study demonstrated that five land types including residential land, industrial land, land for storage, land for roads and square, and land for municipal public facilities had strong correlation with the economic development in Kunming, which indicated that these lands had certain promotion functions. The results explained that it was necessary to enhance the development and utilization of above five types of land under the current economic development background. In accordance with the actual development status, sound utilization of the mutual relation between land resources and economics would be of great significance to the coordinated development of the economics.

articleTitle: Intelligent Monitoring System Based on the Multi-network Integration
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper uses 3G, Zig Bee, VPN 3 techniques and uses heterogeneous network, designs the intelligent agriculture monitoring system based on multi-network integration, achieve on-site remote monitoring. It is applied to the actual, the results show that the design is stable, better.

articleTitle: Sustainable Dynamic Supervision of Construction Safety Production License
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: By establishing judgment matrix study dynamic regulation of sustainable production safety license under construction, consideration of the standard model of quality management, safety production license conditions, the enterprise itself and related industries to assist the regulatory implementation of the composition and the like, to give enterprises, production safety supervisor department, its relation to the three dynamic regulation, in coordination between enterprises and production safety authorities, based on game analysis, the relationship between the two scientific proof.

articleTitle: Based on FCE CMI the Choice of Translation Strategies
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper analyses the composition of the CMI, selecting appropriate indicators, evaluation relationships between instruction and translation strategy is established. Fuzzy mathematics comprehensive evaluation results showed that manual translation strategy of traditional Chinese medicine should be applied flexibly, CMI parts using different methods, translation of the names of the most important traditional Chinese medicine. Results data: "indications of illness" and "vendor information" the equivalence theory is better, "name" and "ingredients" should adopt the functional equivalent translation, "features of traditional Chinese medicine" SKOPOS is suitable for translation.

articleTitle: English Language Statistical Machine Translation Oriented Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In this paper, we study on the problem of statistical machine translation (SMT) for English language, and the main innovation is that we introduce the SVM classifier to solve this problem. Particularly, the process of statistical machine translation is constructed of two modules, that is, 1) constructing the target-language sentence, and 2) translating from target texts to source texts language. Afterwards, framework of the statistical machine translation system is provided. The main idea of statistical machine translation is in that the sentence with highest probability is selected by optimizing an objective function, which describes the relationships between source language sentences and target language sentences. Finally, experimental results demonstrate that our proposed algorithm outperforms Topic-Based SMT and Rule-Based SMT.

articleTitle: Effect of Fountain on Variation of Aero-anion and Its Correlation with Meteorological Factors
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: As a new resource, aero-anion is known as "air vitamin and auxin", and it is of great significance for improving air quality in the city. In this paper, floating fountains of the Songhua River in Jilin are the research subjects, measuring its surrounding aero-anion concentrations, temperature, relative humidity, and wind speed and wind direction. The authors studied the variation of aero-anion concentrations around the fountain and its correlative factors. The results showed that: the aero-anion concentrations significantly increased after the fountain opened, aero-anion concentrations were quite different from the fountain in the center at different distances, aero-anion concentrations and relative humidity and wind speed showed a positive correlation in the environmental, and wind direction had a greater impact on aero-anion concentrations around the fountain.

articleTitle: The Trend Analysis of the Second Industrial Structure Changes in Yunnan Province of China Based on the Big Data Technology and Dynamic Shift-Share Method Analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper uses the methods of big data technology and shift-share method to analyze the second industrial structure changes in Yunnan province in the years from 2003 to 2012. The results unveils that the overall situation of the second industry in Yunnan is better than the estimation. However,there are obvious problems in the internal structure of each department. Among them ,the production and supply of electricity, gas and water are relatively worse so far. Construction is the developing the best among the four industrial departments. This paper has given out measures to improve for the existing problems.

Author Keywords: the technology of big data and its application
trend changes of the second industrial structure

articleTitle: Research on Detection System of Automobile Flat Slab Brake Tester
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Braking performance is one of the important performances of vehicle active safety. Accurate and efficient detection system for braking performance is of great significance in improving the security of automobiles. The detection system is based on graphical programming language Lab VIEW and aimed at a flat slab automobile brake tester. It uses NI PCI-6251 cooperating with board connectors to gather the data. It realizes real-time detection of the data such as wheel braking force and others. According to the latest national standard 7258-2012 GB, the system actualizes calculation of braking force balance by programs. Experiments show that the system is reliable and stable, and it features with accurate detection, intuitive interface and convenient debugging.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology for Data Storage in Smart Community Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In this paper, based on demand on data services of smart community, a research on data storage technology of DRTDB is conducted and data exchange strategy in MMDB is put forward, which is finally applied in smart community platform. In addition, comparison between effect achieved by such strategy and that achieved by common database is conducted, which indicates that such strategy has a huge advantage in data processing speed and thus can meet requirements of the platform on data processing.

articleTitle: 3D Numerical Modeling of Wind-Driven Flow in the High Salinity Aibi Lake
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: According to the hydrodynamic characteristics of high salinity lake, a three dimensional hydrodynamic numerical model is built to simulate the flow in Aibi Lake in northwest China. Selecting typical wind fields, to simulate the formation process of wind driven flow and 3D spatial distribution characteristics of hydrodynamic parameters. The study result shows that the formation process of wind driven flow can be divided into three stages: The flow direction is consistent with wind direction in the initial stage, the flow direction deviates from the wind direction in the transitional stage and the current ultimately forms a stable circulation in the last stage. When the flow field is on steady state, the flow direction in most of the zones are in consistent with the wind direction while there are several small scale circulations in central. The bottom current in central is opposite to that in surface, which shows compensation current character. Overall, the horizontal velocity from the surface to the bottom is decreasing. The water velocity near inshore is greater than that in center. The distribution characteristics of hydrodynamic parameters in high salinity lake are similar to that of fresh water. The water salinity has no effect on the structure of lake circulation.

articleTitle: Island Detection System Based on Multi-criteria
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Island detection is an essential protecting action in a distributed generating system. Island detecting is generally divided into two kinds, one is active island detecting, another is passive island detecting. The disturbance signal in active island detecting always causes pollution to power quality while the passive island detecting has long detecting time and large dead zone. All the existing detection methods have blind zone which cause detection failure. Aiming at blind zone in island detection, this paper presents wavelet entropy and pattern recognition to analyze. And then combining it with passive island detecting, which can reduce even eliminate blind zone. This paper simulates in Mat lab, and then develops a device to verify the method this paper presents.

articleTitle: Multidimensional Assessment Results Data Mining and Analysis for Courses of Science
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This system adopts the decision tree ID3 algorithm and the teachers' classroom teaching quality evaluation attribute are classified and evaluation attribute characteristic of each category is obtained. The result of the rules of data mining are analyzed and the analysis results are applied to improve the level of teaching quality, which has very strong practical significance. By using data mining technique, multidimensional assessment results are deeply analyzed, so that we can more clearly find out correlation between factors influencing the quality of classroom teaching of science course. Then we can help the teaching management and teachers to solve teaching problem and improve the quality of classroom teaching of science course.

articleTitle: Study on the Parametric Design of Offshore Platform Outfittings Based on Sinovation Software
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Parametric design has been applied widely in actual production. In this paper, there is an example of a bolt type and hydraulic lifting steel Jack-up offshore platform, the model was created and assembled based on the three-dimensional modeling function of Sinovation software. Firstly the characteristics and the process of parametric design are elaborated in this study. Then it analyzes the key technology and detailed steps of parametric design through the modeling of offshore platform out fittings. By making use of parametric design, a complete relation of assembly relation between adjacent parts is established.

articleTitle: Based on Social Network Theory Security Identity Authentication Protocol Research on MANET
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In the backdrop of the social network theory, Mobile Ad Hoc Network(MANET) security risks, and technical problems faced by is particularly important. Wireless self-organizing network with the traditional network in there are many different places, but they all have the same purpose of solving the problem of information security and identity authentication etc. This paper mainly studies the MANET security authentication protocol, because each other between the sensor and the gateway node provide relevant certification is always a difficult problem to the field, and the security is not guaranteed under offline password guessing attacks, in order to overcome these gaps, this paper puts forward the improvement scheme, and the solutions are compared with those of the traditional scheme of Das, summed up the improvement plan to improve the effectiveness and safety of the original agreement.

articleTitle: Effects of Organic Substrate Compositions on Yield and Quality of Chinese Cabbage
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The effects of different substrate composition on Chinese cabbages' growth, yield and quality in the substrate culture was explored. Six substrate compositions were designed by volume ration and the control plant s were cultivated in soil. The organic soil mixed with composed cow dung, rice husk, wheat straw, chicken dung and Sheep dung were used as substrate for Chinese cabbage cultivation to compare the yield and nutrient quality in ordinary soil. The available nutrient of organic substrates control remarkably. Organic substrates showed a suitable bulk density and porosity. The EC and pH of substrates were a bit too high at the beginning, but decreased to the suitable range in fruit stage(EC<;2.5 ms/cm, pH 5.5 -- 7.5). The results showed that Chinese cabbage cultivated with organic substrate grew better than that in ordinary soil, and the yield in organic soil could increase up to 80.4%. The Chinese cabbage cultivated under organic substrate had high content of crude protein content, total sugar and vitamin C. The content of heavy metals planted in organic substrate composition was far less than the limited standards of that in the pollution-free vegetables and food. Such experiment seemed that organic substrate cultivation could be used in Chinese cabbage to increase yield and improve nutrient quality.

articleTitle: The Web Services Platform to Improve the Research and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This article is mainly for Web services platform design and implementation of the corresponding analytical technology, and its research and development of the whole process, from the technical level of the Web services platform to show in all directions.

articleTitle: University Innovative Personnel Assessment Research Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Feasibility of innovative personnel assessment based on artificial neural network is demonstrated. The university personnel quality assessment model based on BP neural network is put forward and based on the BP neural network model, evaluation index system of university personnel quality is established. Then these corresponding personnel quality evaluation indexes are transformed into quantitative indicators, making it as an ideal input data of neural network training. It shows that the neural network method can fully absorb the expert judgment experience and makes more accurate judgment.

articleTitle: Research on Performance Evaluation of Large-Scale Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper focuses on the construction and selection of large-scale enterprise performance evaluation. It corrects corresponding evaluation indexes for the limitation of existing evaluation system for enterprises. We adopt the actual operating data of certain province and use factor analysis method and entropy weight method to reselect key performance indexes and assign the weights, and analyze the meaning of each index and the utilization of evaluation method in detail. During empirical analysis, we compare the indexes system for large-scale enterprises to existing schemes. The results show our corrected performance evaluation index system can reflect the real status of the performance of enterprise more scientifically and reasonably.

articleTitle: Method to Analyze the Effect of Concrete Shrinkage and Creep on Widened T-Beam Bridges
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: An analytical method is put forward to study the shrinkage and creep effects of concrete on widened T-beam bridge, important formulas are deduced to analyze the stress and deflection of the old and new T-beams, which are connected together to construct the widened bridge. Take a 20 m span widened bridge as an example, the height of the new T-beams are analyzed specifically to disclose the law of the effect of shrinkage and creep on the deflection and stress of T beams.

articleTitle: College Students Mental Health Assessment System Design Based on J2EE
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: According to the development of our colleges mental health educational background and environment, we'd analyze the architecture of mental health assessment system, using the J2EE structure and SQL SERVER as the database structure, My Eclipse as development environment. Assessment system becomes the key to improve the level of education of college mental health and reduces the mental health of teachers' workload.

articleTitle: Construction Strategy of Sloping Building Base on Site Character Analysis: Taking Heyuan Newspaper Media Center as an Example
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The area of sloping land is about 2/3 of the total area in China, and the construction activity on the slope land is much more than people's imagination. But in many cases, because of the complexity of the sloping land, architects are more willing to level the ground before construction. And it results in a great waste. More critical, the terrain of the unique sloping land is disappeared because of the land clearance. And the site character of the building cannot be well reflected, so the building lacks personality. This paper discusses the architectural design strategy of sloping building. And we try to express the special site character through the construction of sloping building, so we can create a unique architectural features and unique visual effect.

articleTitle: Summary of Statistical Prediction of Posttranslational Modification Sites in Proteins
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Most proteins perform their functions after post-translational modifications (PTMs). Post-translational modifications play crucial roles in various cell functions and biological process. Computational identification of PTMs is an important way in contrast to experimental approach with its convenience. This review gave the process for prediction of Post-translational modification sites including benchmark dataset, feature construction, algorithm, evaluation measurement, and online web-server. Feature construction which reflects intrinsic correlation with proteins was emphasized mainly. Seven feature construction methods containing physiochemical properties and sequence information have been illustrated principally. Last nitro tyrosine was an application to design a site-specific predictor. The procedure was clearly described.

articleTitle: The AHP Analysis of the Reform and Innovation of Chinese Art Education in the Context of Globalization
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper first analyzes the necessity of the reform and innovation of art education in China. Then it analyzes the problems of art education reform in our country by using the game theory and evolutionary game theory, and obtains the optimal strategy for the government and relevant departments. Finally, through AHP analysis, we find out the difficulties in the process of art education reform in China, and obtain the important measures to promote the reform of art education.

Author Keywords: the Reform and Innovation of Chinese Art Education

articleTitle: Based on the Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model on the Analysis of Lu Embroidery Pattern Artistic Value
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Shandong Lu embroidery patterns art is a unique traditional art forms, is one of the representatives of Chinese culture heritage. With the traditional cultural heritage and protection, more and more research on Lu embroidery patterns are constantly deepened. In this paper, research on artistic value evaluation Lu embroidery patterns, the establishment of Lu embroidery patterns artistic value evaluation model based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation. Lu embroidery patterns by affecting the artistic value of the impact between the elements of art Decomposition Lu embroidery patterns of hierarchical organization constituted by fuzzy evaluation of each factor affecting the relationship between the final calculated Lu embroidery patterns for the evaluation model. For the evaluation of Lu embroidery patterns played a scientific quantitative analysis. To evaluate Lu embroidery patterns of development and artistic value provides a reference, it can play a guiding role in the development of Lu embroidery patterns, provide some help for the development of Lu embroidery art.

articleTitle: Turbulence Parameters Calculation of Gasoline Engine Combustion Process
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: First of all, a quasi-dimensional turbulent combustion model is established in this article, which is verified by experiments. Finally, the turbulent parameters in the process of gasoline engine combustion are calculated by using the model.

articleTitle: New Multi-level Routing Protocols MLRP of Car MANET
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In order to meet the communications needs of car MANET with low latency, high-rate, through the analysis of Numerous classical routing protocol, we propose a new multi-level clustering routing protocol MLRP, this protocol is designed to reduce the effect of moving the nodes and routing protocol for routing discovery process of flooding overhead. Its fast-forwarding mechanism to accelerate the search by the process and its local route repair mechanism limits the extension link bad area, and improve the speed of the network restoration. Simulation results show that in the case of car MANET topology rapidly changing, the protocol can effectively shorten the route addressing times, and reduce the transmission delay while increasing throughput.

articleTitle: Computer Remote Control System of Network Security Research
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In the computer and network communication technology rapid development, the use of remote control system and its security technology also obtained the very big development. This article mainly analysis the structure of the computer network remote control system, analyze the current computer network environment, security problems faced by remote control. And emphasis on computer remote control system of the concrete application of network security technology.

articleTitle: Cruise Tourism Product Developing Model Optimization Based on Demand Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper analyzes the developing process of cruise tourism product at home and abroad and propose further analysis on existing problems on domestic market, to put forward a novel idea for cruise tourism product. By analysis we take the demand feature including navigation time, port of call, etc. Into account to establish cruise route optimization model. Aiming at the largest tourist volume and the minimum operating costs and routing time and tourist quantity are taken as the constraint, we simulate the interactive relationship between the route structure and the number of visitors. The design is based on the improved algorithm and solution model based on matrix coding, to compute the route scheme and routine income under balance status. At last the model is solved by programming and the computation results of model are verified to be matched with the demand of consumers, which also meets the actual case of our country.

articleTitle: The Application of Case-Based Reasoning Retrieve in Course Timetabling
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The structured representation of cases by attribute graphs in a Case-Based Reasoning (CBR) system for university course timetabling has been the subject of previous research by the authors. In that system, the case base is organized as a decision tree and the retrieval process chooses those cases that have similar (sub-) structures and attributes to the new case. The drawback of that approach is that it is not suitable for solving large problems. This paper presents a multiple-retrieval approach that partitions the attribute graph of the large problem into small solvable sub-problems by recursively inputting the unsolved part of the graph into the decision tree for retrieval. The adaptation combines the retrieved partial solutions of all the partitioned sub-problems and employs a graph heuristic method to construct the whole solution for the new case. Good results are obtained from a wide range of experiments. An evaluation of the CBR system is presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Based on the Software Development of Network Technology Research
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The network software development is the most important part of computer network using the network application technology based on software development is a key link in software development system. At present, network software development is mainly based on framework technology model, according to the actual functional requirements of software, can choose a different framework to develop independently or in groups. This article mainly introduces the network framework of software development technology, by understanding its connotation, analyzes its principle, and based on the network, and the implementation process of software development technology.

articleTitle: Evaluation of ERP Polygraph Technology in Hidden Information Based on P300 and CNV with BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In recent years, legal society has become the mainstream in development of the times. It requires evidence of a crime in any case, whereby the testimony of criminals become more important. However, the effectiveness of testimony becomes concerned issue. ERP hidden information polygraph technology, as a new type of technology, is particularly important in case management. In this paper, P300 and CNV indicators were studied with AHP, selecting a suitable indicator used in crimes of theft. Based on BP neural network model, comparative experiment as a reference, both from the tester's reaction time and waveform amplitude, evaluation model was established to provide a theoretical basis for the future.

articleTitle: Research on the Selection of Logistics Suppliers Considering Cost and Reliability
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Incentive mechanism for logistics service provider's service quality improvement is studied. First, we design a revenue sharing contract to promote logistics provider quality improved behavior. The effect of the contract without counting the opportunism behavior is analyzed. The results show that the contract can encourage logistics provider to improve logistics service quality. Second, in view of logistics provider's opportunistic behavior, we established an evolution model combining reward and punishment using the evolutionary game theory. The results show that only combining reward and punishment, the mechanism can play a good incentive effect. Finally, on the basis of the above research, some advices on the logistics services integrator cooperation with logistics provider are given.

articleTitle: Safety Assessment for Down-Hole Casings in Well Completion under High Temperature and High Pressure Environment
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper concentrates on the problem of safety assessment for down-hole casings in well completion, and we constrain the environment in high temperature and high pressure. Firstly, in order to analyze casing wear depth, we establish a suitable wear prediction model, in which friction and sliding distance coefficient between drill string and down-hole casing are utilized. Secondly, a novel safety assessment method for down-hole casings in well completion is proposed. In particular, we convert the down-hole casing safety assessment to the wear depth calculation problem. Finally, in the experiment we use a dataset which is collected from down-hole casings in well completion. Experimental demonstrate that the proposed method can effectively assess safety degree of down-hole casings in well completion.

articleTitle: A Network Model Research for Emergency Supply Database
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: For the question that how to show the emergency supply in the software, a mathematical model is developed in this paper. The mathematical model distinguishes connecting sides, nodes from different networks, which includes modeling events as material information, information of transporting vehicles, scheduling schemes, and disaster points. Then according to requirements of the modeling elements and relationships between different modeling elements, the constraints are established. At the end, we developed software which can show the mathematical model is reasonable.

articleTitle: A Novel Risk Control Method for Commercial Bank
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: On the basis of depth study of commercial bank credit risk control model literature, this paper introduced the concepts of credit risk and credit risk control. We research the main influencing factors of commercial bank credit risk control scientifically by artificial neural network theory, and then set a commercial bank credit risk control index system which contains 3 levels of 27 indexes. Improved BP Neural Networks is selected as the commercial bank credit risk control model on the basis of comparison among representative models. Finally, MATLAB software is used for empirical analysis with 144 companies' financial data. The results show that the discriminate accuracy rate of this model is higher than the standard BP neural network and Logistic regression model, which proves that this model could effectively control the credit risk of commercial banks corporate customers. The results of this research provides a useful method for the commercial bank credit risk control and has a certain reference.

articleTitle: Cultural Promote Economic Development under the Factor Analysis - in Japan, for Example
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Based on analysis of the key factors of Japanese culture to the country's economic development has made outstanding contributions, particularly in the Japanese anime culture, sports and culture is characterized by the formation of a strong cultural industry system. Further, as a manifestation of national consciousness and the national spirit, culture affects the formation of individual corporate culture, and gradually promote the rapid increase in Japan's national economy and abundant reserves, the paper extract promote cultural factors in economic terms, namely: enterprise culture, national consciousness and consumer culture, education and innovation culture, and to assess the factors influence these factors.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Large Data High-Performance Sorting Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This article mainly aims at the sorting algorithm of the era of big data analysis, for the ranking method of a series of corresponding research, and for the realization of the algorithm in this series.

articleTitle: Experiment on the Natural Ventilation of Corncob in Different Size Rectangular Barns
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Moisture content, humidity, wind speed and temperature were measured by the monitoring system in order to analyze the energy change in the process of moisture migration and optimize the barn structure. The results showed that high water area concentrated in the west side of bottom in four barns. Absolute water potential and corn temperature were on the rise as the same as the drying rate. Wind speed and drying rate were all appeared a low value between January and February. Width size of barn caused the ventilation evenness, and corn equilibrium moisture content evenness in number 1 barn was lower than others. Ventilation evenness of number 4 was best but the drying rate was inferior to the number 3. In conclusion, the structure of the number 3 rectangle barn was more reasonable.

articleTitle: Vibration Control Research on Single-Story Bidirectional Eccentric Isolated Structure
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In order to reduce the seismic response of the bidirectional eccentric structure, adopting isolation measures for vibration control of structures. This paper discusses the dynamic response of the structure under the condition of non-isolation measures and isolation measures. Proved by numerical calculation, isolation device contributes to the translational and torsional vibration control of the structure, the translational and torsional vibration damping effect of the maximum can reach 40.74% and 35.99% respectively. Thus, it is clear that the base isolation can significantly reduce the torsional response of the structure. Isolation device can be used as an effective control measure for the torsional vibration of eccentric structures based on the advantages of simple, economic and easy to implement.

articleTitle: Psychology Predictive Model Research Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: College students' mental health has also become a important question which is related to stability of family, university and society. Ten number of major factors that affects college students' mental health is taken as the input samples. Weight of BP neural network is optimized by genetic algorithm and college students' mental health prediction system is put forward. We can in advance predict students who may have psychological problems so as to give corresponding attention or corresponding measures in time to achieve the school's stability and unity.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Household Gas Monitoring System Based on Zigbee + GPRS Communication
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: A design scheme of gas monitoring system based on Zigbee + GPRS is presented in this paper. The gas data is collected from the gas sensor and it uploads to the ARM gateway using WSN technology Zigbee. It can be intelligently control of the local gas valve, exhaust fan, alarm lights and windows through the WSN after data analysis, then it solves the problem caused by the gas in time. At the same time, It reminds the users to remotely control of the household gas and control system after getting alarm by GPRS technology in time. With Its characteristic of intelligent, remote control, easy installation, low cost and security, this scheme is a good option for modern smart home.

articleTitle: The Construction of Improved Data Structure in Computer Software Development and Research of Contribution under Mechanism Analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In this article, studied the computer software development through the mechanism analysis method, and established improved data structure diagrams. It affirmed the importance of demand analysis in the software development process. First, introduced the concept of mechanism analysis, computer software development and demand analysis. Secondly, comprehensive evaluation was used for studying the several graphical tools in the process of requirements analysis. Screening of the most beneficial method of data analysis, which were data flow diagrams and structure of language. Finally, we gained the improved data structure which combined with the two ways of data flow diagrams and structured language to describe the data stream of complex problems.

articleTitle: The Era of Big Data of Image Retrieval and Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The development of identification technique for image retrieval and use, to build a specific development environment and get away, will identify library, combining the mainstream technology of basic theory in the field of this problem is to identify problems, is also a basic problem of image retrieval. The realization and application of image retrieval identification library for building research, is a positive role in promoting.

articleTitle: Fangxin - A Reference Model for Big Data Reliable Computing on User Character Extracting
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper proposes a reference model for big data reliable computing on user character extracting based on MapReduce. Further, a detailed design of MapReduce based on weighted plain Bayesian classification method is introduced in this paper. The evaluation proves that the weighted plain Bayesian classification works for enhancing the chance of getting the classification more obviously.

articleTitle: Service Recommendation Method on Multiple Dimension O2O
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The concept of O2O caught great interests from operators and researchers. Although O2O brings great opportunity to the market, the chaos and lack of credit make big problems to the thrive of O2O. The context and preference clustering model is proposed in this paper to study the affection of both customer context and service preference. The proposed model aims to realize a clustering method for both sides, looking for a service recommendation strategy. Test results showed that the proposed assumptions worked well in the model.

articleTitle: A Survey of Warehousing Technology in Electronic Commerce Supermarket
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: With the further popularization of Internet in China, the electronic commerce (E-commerce) supermarkets come into being, and the competition between them will ultimately transformed to be the competition of back-end logistics. Improve the warehousing technique has become the key to promote logistics services and win more consumers. Thus, it will be very important to study the significance, planning and operations of the E-commerce supermarkets.

articleTitle: Design and Establishment of Discipline Knowledge Map in Network
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This article aimed at the questions that learner exists in the current study, and proposed the tentative plan through constructs "Discipline knowledge map" in the network environment to guidance study. Carried on the plan and the design to the knowledge map in the network, and developed a discipline knowledge map model of electronic technology domain using network database, network programming, browser cartography technical method and so on, expected to help studies of the learner. Summarized the significance of the research.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the International Trade Settlement System
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper studies on the problem of international trade settlement system design and implementation, which is very useful to solve the problems in traditional international trade business transactions. Framework of the international trade settlement system is made up of three modules: 1) Trade finance business processing model, 2) Quasi credit card business processing, and 3) Host interface processing. Afterwards, functions of international trade settlement software include three parts: 1) Import letters of credit business process, 2) Export documents business process, and 3) Business Process Guarantee. Next, we provide the formal description of the data process algorithm of the proposed system. To test the performance of our system, NBER-UN dataset is utilized, and top ten countries in international trade of the year 2013 are calculated.

articleTitle: The Fuzzy Power Control in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The nodes in wireless sensor networks are broadcasted randomly causes the distribution of the nodes and the clusters asymmetrical. This situation affects performance of networks. The power control technology of cluster heads was needed to optimize framework of networks. However, it is difficult to set up mathematic modeling. Therefore the power control technology in wireless sensor networks is proposed in this paper, that the node number in the cluster can be fallen in a reasonable range by adjusting transmit power of the head.

articleTitle: Information Use and the International Intellectual Property Protection in Big Data Era
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The era of big data, huge amounts of information provides convenient conditions for production and life. Big data has a huge amount of data and characteristic of diversity, quickness and accuracy. From an economic point of view, big data is a new type of resource, it put all into the era of knowledge economy, From a legal point of view, big data is a new type of property rights, it is in line with the international protection of intellectual property. Current our country in order to deepen reform, improve the international competition strength, made in China is to improve the protection of intellectual property rights of the data information.

articleTitle: Education Resource Knowledge Management Model Based on Topic Maps and Knowledge Relevance Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: With the popularization of network technology and higher level educational information, education in the field of knowledge management has become a research hotspot. The knowledge point is an essential cell which transferred information in teaching. Automatically extracted from the network a lot of teaching resources in knowledge and information, and then translates the information into the corresponding elements of topic maps. A model of educational resources knowledge management based on topic maps is put forward. The method of semantic relatedness of topic maps evaluation among topics and between topic and resources to be studied, which can be applied to knowledge services. For example, knowledge navigation system, constitute the new navigation system, the precise concept of association, narrow the search space, returns the sorted result set, enhance knowledge retrieval, efficiency and accuracy of navigation.

articleTitle: How to Perform Incremental Clustering - A SOM Based View
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Due to fast development of network technique, internet users have to face to massive textual data every day. Because of unsupervised merit of clustering, clustering is a good solution for users to analyze and organize texts into categories. However, most of recent clustering algorithms conduct in static situation. That indicates, it doesn't allow clustering algorithm to deal with novel data efficiently. When novel data appear, traditional clustering algorithms can't change their structure easily. Obviously, this restrict is not fit to internet, since novel data appear at any time. For this reason, an incremental clustering algorithm is proposed in this paper to cluster incremental data. This algorithm has two factors. (a) It designs two measures to calculate feature's ability and integrate them in similarity measurement by replacing concurrence based similarity measurements. (b) Based on proposed similarity measurement, this algorithm selects few samples from original texts to perform incremental clustering. Experimental results demonstrate that, after integrating feature's capacity, our algorithm can obtain high quality to cluster texts.

articleTitle: On Ecological Utilization of Discarded Building Materials Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Along with the sustained and rapid development of economy in China, especially the rapid urban development, the development of the construction industry has reached a new level. However in the urban development, discarded building materials are problems to which we have to pay attention as well. At present, most of discarded building materials in our country are treated as waste by landfill or outdoor display. These problems have brought huge resource consumption to city and pollute the environment meanwhile. With the lack of energy sources and the aggravation of the environmental problems in our country, ecological utilization of discarded building materials becomes an issue that our country has to face. This paper offers some suggestions for the development of ecological utilization of discarded building materials by comparing between domestic and foreign cases of ecological utilization of discarded building materials.

articleTitle: Vehicle Dynamic Characteristics Analysis by Using Root Locus
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Root locus method is the common analysis method in the classical control theory, it can judge the types of system transient response intuitively to analyze if the system can achieve the stationary state without solving differential equation. Qualitative analysis of the impact the change simulation parameters main vehicle steering characteristics of the vehicle, according to the vehicle structure parameter changes cause the system to change the type of the transient response, reaction to the nature of the various branches of the root locus on the same trend of root locus vehicle structural parameters obtained The reasonable range. In this paper, based on the three degrees of freedom vehicle model, we derived characteristic equation model to analyze the impact on vehicle handling stability by changes of speed, yaw moment of inertia as well as front and rear cornering stiffness, and obtain the reasonable range of yaw moment of inertia and front and rear cornering stiffness based on vehicle simulation.

articleTitle: Research on the Integration of Railway Planning and Urban Planning
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The rapid development of China's economy directly promotes the development of the city, as the city is growing, people's travel distance is also correspondingly longer, so it need to use a certain means of transport, which is responsible for the inter city rail transportation. The Cheng Yu intercity railway network as the research object, first of all to Chongqing last year GDP, population and traffic with binary linear regression analysis, passenger traffic volume on the GDP and population relationship can be obtained and forecast future passenger traffic. And then through the gray prediction (GM1.1) model to predict the proportion of railway transportation in previous years, the proportion of future railway can be obtained, and then get the railway passenger traffic volume.

Author Keywords: Intercity railway network The binary linear regression Gray forecast Urban agglomeration structure

articleTitle: A Multi-channel Spectrum Auto-monitor for Satellite Communications Signal
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: A multi-channel spectrum on-line auto-monitor method for satellite communications signal is designed, which is different from the traditional single-channel method based on the spectrum analyzer. To realize the novel method, a suitable signal monitoring point is selected firstly, a system architecture of "monitoring point & directional coupler & integrated matrix network & spectrum test unit & monitoring terminal" is built secondly, and a comprehensive testing software is used for testing points selection and testing indicators control. As a result, real-time multi-channel spectrum signal analysis, threshold alarms and continuous sampling process saving is realized. Proven, real-time, and high data accuracy, improve work efficiency, the promotion and practical value.

articleTitle: Establishment and Application of Comprehensive Evaluation Model for Athletes
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Results of track and field with the sweat that subject to the results of a competition, there are technical decisions, factors affecting athletes as well as a variety of other factors. Therefore, a comprehensive and integrated evaluation for track and field athletes is necessary, through analysis of the calculated weight of the non-quantified targets, using grey model to calculate the measurement's weight, combined with the expertise to evaluate the performance of athletes. Results showed that the evaluation results and the competing opponent results broadly in line with, and can be used as a model for comprehensive evaluation of track and field athletes.

articleTitle: Vehicle Roll Stability Analysis Based on Root Locus
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Based on vehicle theory and dynamic analysis, vehicle dynamics model is established. By comparing different evaluation method, root locus analysis method is put forward to analyze vehicle roll stability. Combined with the principle of vehicle system dynamics and force analysis, four degree of freedom vehicle system equation is established for dynamics simulation. The dynamic model is solved by using the state equation and Mat lab software is used to program the simulation. Through the research of turning characteristic under the condition of fixed speed, and under input conditions of different steering wheel angle, yaw rate and roll angle of root locus variations were analyzed, and roll stability of vehicle is analyzed and evaluated. The results show that stability of vehicle roll system can be well analyzed and evaluation by the method of root locus analysis.

articleTitle: PPS Sampling Based on Correlation Research
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: PPS sampling has been widely used in the sampling survey, which uses the scale variable as the auxiliary information for the corresponding sampling design and estimation. With the development of various technologies and the advent of big data era, more and more available information turns up in the actual survey, how to select the appropriate variables as auxiliary information is a very important question. Indicator variable is introduced in the pps sampling. Then application method of auxiliary variable in the pps sampling is investigated.

articleTitle: The Characteristic Analysis of Key Contamination Zone around Discharge Outlet after Water Storage of Three Gorges Reservoir Using 2D Numerical Model
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Adopted a depth average two dimension non-invariablenes current numerical matrix, flow characteristics and permanganate index (CODMn) concentration field of Chuanweichang contamination zone around discharge outlet after water storage at water level of 156m have been simulated. Furthermore, Contamination zone around discharge outlet distribution figure were drew using TECPLOT software. Particularly, characteristic analysis close tied to forecast results. It indicated as below, river way broaden and water depths increase nearby the discharge outlet, velocity of flow which was 1.5 meter per second by nature precipitate into 0.3 meter per second. A distinct backwater area which bring on pollutant localizing durative is ill affected towards river way landform nearby and upriver the discharge outlet. In conclusion, the water environment capability nearby the discharge outlet diminish rapidness than natively status. All drain pattern of dispose up to par, non-dispose and contaminated accident will still come into being exceedable background and water quality standard contamination zone. But it still answered water area function needs in dispose up to par drainage due to situated Changshou development use area.

articleTitle: Estimating System of Project Cost Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Today, the subway has become an important means of transport. However, the huge construction project of subway has not yet formed a complete system in the budget. Taking Guangzhou Metro Line as an example, by BP neural network model, two evaluation model about station cost fees and range expenses were established. At the station costs, take the cost the station and extending into account. In the range of costs, take the range cost and the extending fees into account. In addition, the cost of subway basic data was normalized to the benefits of distributed data. The model will help to quickly conduct the subway cost budget evaluation.

articleTitle: Platform Based E-Commerce Credit Evaluation System Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of e-commerce, e-commerce has been constantly promoting economic and technological progress. In particular, the research on the integrity system of platform type electronic commerce has received more and more attention. In this paper, we establish a platform based e-commerce credit evaluation model based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation. The weights are determined by the analytic hierarchy process, and then the membership degree of each factor is determined. Finally, the model is verified by the actual case. The results show that the evaluation system and method in this paper is feasible and effective in solving practical problems. It provides the scientific basis for the platform of electronic commerce credit evaluation system of our country. It has a very good practical significance to establish a scientific and reasonable evaluation system of the electronic commerce integrity.

Author Keywords: platform type E - commerce credit evaluation

articleTitle: Foreign Language Online Course Evaluation Platform Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: With the development of multimedia network technology, distance education has entered a new phase based on the network. Online-education has been involved in the higher education, basic education, training institutions and other educational fields. This paper puts forward fuzzy comprehensive evaluation process for foreign language online course. Then we combine ASP technology and relational database, foreign language online course evaluation system is designed, which has a certain guiding significance for course evaluation and course design.

articleTitle: Government Management Information System Based on J2EE
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Current social development has shown the importance of information technology for government management and the previous management system was decentralized and independent, which not only increased the cost of management, but also could not meet today's complex application, so the development of government management information system becomes particularly important. We introduce J2EE related technologies and analyze government management system requirements. On this basis, it gives the system's platform to achieve send and receive text management, conference management, bulletin management, employee information management, document management and the office management. Finally, function modules of government management information system are tested and the result shows that designed system has good effect.

articleTitle: Source Inversion of a Sudden Pollution Accident Occurred in Plain River Network Based on Pattern Search Method
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The identification of pollution sources is the foundation of sudden pollution accident warning and emergency rescue work. This paper builds a general method of determining the source of a sudden pollution accident occurred in plain river network by combining pattern search method with one-dimensional hydrodynamic and water quality model. The calculated concentration values obtained from the water quality model are compared with the corresponding monitoring values, and the fitness of them is treated as an objective function. This objective function is iteratively optimized with the pattern search method until a given tolerance has achieved. Finally, assesses the method with an actual pollution event. The results show that this general method of determining the source of a sudden pollution accident occurred in plain river network is feasible, and can provide theoretical supports for emergency rescue work and legal liability investigation once similar accidents happened in plain river network.

articleTitle: The Mathematical Model of Urumqi Road Dust PGEs Accumulation Process Based on Cubic Spline Function
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The number of cars and PGEs values are obtained from 2005 to 2008 which is not observed by the difference method according to the practical observation data. It is concluded that the relation and laws between Rh, Pd, PT and the traffic, by fitting the data from 2004 to 2010 respectively. And we made the final data in 2011 compared with actual observations, We analyzed the reasons which generated the error.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Decision Supported System of Marketing Management for Small Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The role played by the Marketing Management & Decision Supported System (MMDSS) in CIMS is analyzed in this paper. Developing advanced marketing decision-making system to improve management and scientific decision level of enterprise marketing is needed. System framework, which includes support level, data management level, decision tool level and decision level, is given. Aided decision tools composed by OLAP, simulation analysis, expert system are designed. The functional composition for MMDSS is studied. The solution for decision delay is discussed, which includes marketing research, competitive intelligence and marketing risk evaluation & early warning.

articleTitle: The Programming of Mel Frequency Cepstrum Coefficient (MFCC) Difference's Characteristic Extraction of Parameters and Emulation
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Characteristic extraction is one of the main progresses of identification and features of this extraction must reflect not only the nature of targets but also the differences between them, in order to help the recognition unit to make classifying recognition. In this article, we study and research the characteristics of a variety of ship radiated noise spectrum, extracting the features from the perspective of noise spectrum. We have researched the extraction methods of continuous spectrum features, line-spectrum features and one and a half dimension spectrum features. In addition, this article also extracts the Mel differential cepstrum feature coefficient of the ship radiated noise and gives the final results of the simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Status of Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank and the Future Impact Based on System Theory
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Introduce the purpose and significance of Asian infrastructure investment bank, the development process of AIIB and the situation China facing, current research and future research directions based on system theory. It concluded that AIIB would have a bright future.

articleTitle: Analysing the Requirements of Applied Program on the Disk Performance
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The paper expounds the requirement of applied program on the disk performance, narrated how more reasonable disk performance should be designed and its implementation method in detail and finally discussed the importance of disk performance on improving the quick response of applied program.

articleTitle: Developmental Trend of Enrollment and Employment about International Economic Law under the Correction Index
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In this paper, the development trend of enrollment and employment about international economic law were studied. By correcting the exponential curve method, enrollment and employment history were analyzed, and projected the number. First, in principle analysis section introduced the concept of international law and amendment exponential curve method. Secondly, in the part of experimental simulation, forecast the development trend of enrollment and employment about international law by analyzing the international law students enrollment, number of graduates, the number of students, and the projected number of graduates. Eventually found that enrollment and employment situation is getting better and overall upward trend. This facilitates the development of international economic law professional.

articleTitle: Driving-Record-Based Distributed Path-Planning for Autonomous Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The influence from individual preference and circumstance has been considered in the distributed path-planning model which is generated by Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) and Bayesian Theory, and the model parameter can be determined with actual driving records of an optimal path-planning model. The new model develops the previous one from a single path into a distribution based on driving records so that the actual optimal path during driving can be adjusted according to the real-time position, which avoids oscillation along the single path and improves practicality and amenity.

articleTitle: Research of the Relationship between Industrial Structure and Spatial Layout Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The spatial organization relationship of element layout in mountainous areas becomes the new development issue in mountainous areas. The booming valley economy exhibits a wonderful prospect for the development in mountainous areas. However the industry layout is too decentralized and unreasonable. Based on GIS, the paper put forward a more reasonable, more effective space structure.

articleTitle: Study on Status and Countermeasures of Panzhihua Jatropha Mathematical Optimization
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: By an analysis of current situation of Jatropha in panzhihua studied to fully understand current defects and problems in development of Jatropha in panzhihua, targeted the corresponding solutions, provided for the development of Jatropha in panzhihua century strategies. Using a mathematical method to quantify the lack of Jatropha development described, identify the major contradictions. By hierarchical analysis and optimization solutions. Concluded that major problems currently facing the panzhihua Jatropha is the lack of infrastructure investment, an effective response is to improve the scientific research and infrastructure investment.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of the Barn Duct Design on Control Techniques of Pests in Stored Grain
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
