abstract: Firstly on stored grain pest control technology were AHP analysis, find out the factors that affect the behavior of the stored grain pests, put forward effective prevention and treatment programs, and subsequently analyze effect of barn duct design on the prevention and control of stored grain pests. Then detailed analysis the contribution of the rational design of the barn air duct on the prevention and control of stored grain pests that barn duct reasonable design not only against stored grain pests prevention and control technology has great contribution and the barns were also have great contribution.

articleTitle: Analytic Hierarchy of Ideological and Political Education into the Cultural Construction
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Today, while the material and cultural needs, civic and political education gradually increase, mainstream political culture has been spread to achieve the ideological and political education to cultural integration, improve people's ideological and political training, culture and moral qualities. For ideological and political education into building culture, this paper four indicators as the starting point, respectively, and cultural factors into the ideological and political education to achieve integration into the path of ideological and political education and cultural, ideological and political education and cultural integration of thinking is reflected, ideological and political education Acculturation objective basis.

articleTitle: Dynamic Characteristics of Lifting Balance Circuit Based on Differential Pressure Method
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The role of balance valve in the balance circuit is described, and a new differential pressure control method of the balance valve is proposed. In this paper, firstly a dynamic model of lifting balance circuit is established, and the digital simulation is done in MATLAB, at last the results show that work characteristics of the balance valve based on the methods of differential pressure is fast and stable.

articleTitle: Intelligent Forecasting on Composite Regeneration Endpoint of DPF in the Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: A mathematical model based on fuzzy least squares support vector machines has been developed to forecast the composite regeneration endpoint of the diesel particulate filter in Vehicle. The results show that the relative error of forecasting model of composite regeneration endpoint is less than 3.5%, and the oxygen concentration of exhaust gas has the biggest effect on the endpoint of composite regeneration, followed by the mass flow rate of exhaust gas, the microwave power, the temperature of exhaust gas and the amount of cerium-based additive.

Author Keywords: Fuzzy least squares support vector machines

articleTitle: Study on the Function of Computer Technology in the Electronic Commerce Environment Security and Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In this paper, the necessity of building e-commerce environment security system is analyzed in detail, and that the construction of electronic business environment security is not only beneficial to the electronic commerce itself, but also to provide consumers with more excellent consumer environment. Followed by the construction of the security of e-commerce environment was AHP analysis, come to computer technology play a major role in the security of e-commerce environment, as well as e-commerce system to assess the level of risk assessments.

articleTitle: The Safety Evaluation Based on Process-Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In the traditional methods, we uses qualitative and simple quantitative research methods to make the safety evaluation of the scaffolding. Those quantitative methods are affected by subjective judgment, having no scientific evidence. The article makes the scaffolding as a whole to analyze, using the AHP-fuzzy comprehensive safety evaluation method and verifying the former method by fuzzy pattern recognition in the ending of the passage and hoping that it has reference for the project practice. The new method is mor efficient.

articleTitle: The Third Party Logistics Financial Credit Evaluation Model Research Based on Uncertain Information
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Supervision risk of the third party logistics enterprise logistics and logistics financial operating condition is taken as the investigation object in this paper. Through the selection of indicators and determination of the weight coefficient, we build a comprehensive and practical evaluation index system of logistics finance risk. Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is used to construct logistics financial risk assessment model. The proposed model risk is less than the traditional logistics finance business model.

articleTitle: Research on Data Access Security Control Mechanism under Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper studies the improvement and implementation of access control method under ABAC model in detail. By further analysis of encyption principle and algorithm implementation process, and contrast on mainstream ABE algorithms, it selects CP-ABE as access control algorithm for security and performance, to be used in ABAC access control model under cloud computing environment. We improve the algorithm and optimize the system to reduce the computation during access control process. So it can well integrate with ABAC model to protect the privacy of information resource. The tests show the improved scheme has rapid speed in encryption/decryption with ABAC model, and needs smaller storage space, which is also a better encryption mechanism for cloud environment.

articleTitle: Internet + BBS Influence and Countermeasures of College Campus Culture
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The "Internet + BBS" is a typical model, the current campus network environment with deep penetration of computer information technology, college campus network has constructed another virtual campus. The huge amounts of information on the network environment and the complexity of the information, it is clear that the students in colleges and universities ideological cognition has brought some challenges, also brought new challenges for the construction of campus culture. In further analysis the influence of these cases, the targeted adaptation measures, become the important content of college campus culture construction.

articleTitle: CL-KEM Based Password Authenticated Key Exchange Protocol under DDH Assumption
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Three-party password authenticated key exchange protocol is a very practical mechanism to establish secure session key through authenticating each other with the help of a trusted server. Based on certificateless key encapsulation mechanism, we present a specific three-party password authenticated key exchange protocol under DDH assumption. Security analysis showed that the proposed protocol could fulfill all the necessary security requirements.

articleTitle: Study on the Mechanical Properties of Deep Overburden
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The pressure meter is used to do field pressure test on the 15 drill holes in the 4 deep overburden layers where high earth-rock dam is planned to be built, totally 102 reasonable experiment data is obtained with the maximum depth of 85.0m and the maximum test pressure of 4MPa, which is a relatively accurate reflection of the engineering mechanical properties of deep overburden layer as well as its distribution rules. According to the comparison between compression modulus, the laboratory compression test and the field pressure meter test results of deep overburden layer are analyzed. It's found that the difference between the two is obvious, and with the increasing depth of overburden layer, the compression modulus value by laboratory test is significantly smaller than that by the field pressure meter test. It's difficult to accurately determine the engineering mechanical properties and the distribution rules of deep overburden layer by the laboratory test. While the pressure meter test, as an effective method to measure the engineering mechanical properties of deep overburden layer, can avoid the loss of structural strength and the influence of scale effect caused by the disturbance of sampling, therefore it can better reflect such characteristics of the overburden layer as complex structural layers, discontinuous rock stratum, alternation of different sizes of gravels, the phenomena of discontinuous grading of open work boulder, the lenses easily to be horizontally aligned or irregular dissection, etc.

articleTitle: Dynamic Simulation Analysis of Multi-pivot Excavation Structure
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: With the progress of technology, people develop many protection of foundation pit is also more and more, at the same time for multi-pivot of foundation pit engineering are also put forward higher requirements. In this paper, the dynamic simulation of protection of excavation structure simulation analysis, get the change of the stress and displacement of excavation structure, through dynamic simulation results can be seen that: Multi-pivot of foundation pit with the increase of excavation depth, displacement and stress of the supporting structure are changing, due to reasons such as unloading rebound, foundation pit is easy to produce certain uplift, and with the increase of the depth of the uplift degree increases, will eventually stabilise. Due to uplift can lead to loss of stability of the protection of excavation structure, so should take certain measures to control, in order to achieve the purpose of safety construction.

articleTitle: The Water Stability Prediction Model of SMA-16 Modified Asphalt Mixture
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: SMA-16 modified asphalt mixture are designed by referencing the orthogonal design method, the freeze-thaw cycle rutting test are carried out, the related model of the fractal dimension and the water stability evaluation index including freeze-thaw cycle dynamic stability ratio is established by using fractal theory. The water stability of SMA-16 asphalt mixture can be predicted according to the gradation designed. This can reduce the test workload and offer the reference for engineering design.

articleTitle: Study on the Weld Pool 3D Surface Reconstruction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In the present study, based on the analyses of weld pool image processing algorithms, the feasibility of three-dimensional visualization of weld pool using three-dimensional surface reconstruction algorithm was demonstrated. The detailed research scheme, method and technical route were elaborated in this article, and finally the experiments were carried out to verify the feasibility.

articleTitle: TCP Performance Analysis and Algorithm Improved in Ad-Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Many factors affecting the performance of TCP in Ad-Hoc network are analyzed, and a new TCP Vegas-N algorithm is put forward in order to solve the problem that the traditional TCP protocol can not meet the needs of the Ad-Hoc network. Slow-start algorithm, Base RRT and RRT obtaining value method, congestion control algorithm are improved on the basis of TCP Vegas protocol. Simulation results show that the algorithm can effectively solve the packet loss problem which can not be distinguished in the traditional TCP and can adjust the size of congestion window according to the route hop, and the transmission performance of TCP protocol is improved greatly in Ad-Hoc network.

articleTitle: Emergency Supplies Research on Crossing Points of Transport Network Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Crossing points are important parts of transport network for emergency supplies. Crossing points contain two parts: one is the point where different paths cross over in a transportation network, the other is the point where different transportation networks cross. The problem to be solved in the paper is to attain a scheduling scheme for emergency supplies in the transport network with crossing points. A mathematical model is established to describe the problem in the paper. The problem is a combination optimization problem. Therefore we supply Genetic Algorithm for solving the problem. The objective in the paper is to acquire a scheme whose time consumption is the least and meanwhile cost consumption is the lowest. Thanks to the computer's benefits of fast calculation speed, good data storage capacity, scientific calculation, a satisfactory material scheme is acquired through software simulation on the computer.

articleTitle: Use the Means of Engineering Practice to Solve Sewage Box Culvert Design and Operation Based on Experiment Simulation
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Nearby the main large sewage box culvert project as an example, introduces the engineering design after comparing different place, and scheme, box culvert, profile design, the design of the special structures such as detailed introduction, detailed instructions on the place of innovation and is adjacent to the main channel sewage provides a certain experience in engineering design, at the same time provide similar terrain of the city related engineering projects.

articleTitle: A Large Scale Social Network Community Detection Method Based on Probability Model
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In this paper, we study on the problem of large scale social network community detection method, which is an important issue in Online Social Networks data mining. The proposed social network community detection system aims to divide the social network into several communities according to internal relationships among users. Particularly, this system is made up of two steps, that is, 1) detecting the community structure in a specific time period, and 2) discovering the evolution of the social network community. The main idea of this paper is to exploit LDA topic model to mine and analysis the co-occurrence relationship between different words, and then construct word relationship network. Afterwards, LDA model is used to extract community structures from the word relationship network. Finally, experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Mobile Intelligent Terminal Equipment Learning Software Design and Development
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The mobile intelligent terminal equipment represented by smart-phones, applied to the terminal at the beginning of the software in the design and you need to follow applicable, open, short, quantitative goals and principles of humanized. Based on this, in turn, to formulate the overall design of software framework, and through the software development technology to achieve.

articleTitle: A New Method for Calculating the Extreme Water Level Based on Insufficient Data of the New Port
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Design water level is the basic parameter for Marine engineering design, which based on existing hydrological data of the port to calculate. In practice, the correlation between the short-time hydrological data of the newly built port and the long-term hydrological data of the nearby ports are often unable to meet the requirements of the standard calculation of extreme water level, and the result error of approximate calculation is relatively large. This paper take the Changxing Island sea area overall planning project as an example, provides a new method for determining the quantitative index of the tidal similarity and the extreme water level, which can provides reference for the extreme tide level calculation in new port.

articleTitle: Computational Analysis on the Instability Mechanism of Liujiatai Landslide
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The stability of unsaturated soil slope will decrease gradually with the decrease of matric suction. This paper develops the relevant computational software of the transfer coefficient method in the condition of taking matric suction into consideration, makes an analysis on stability of Liujiatai slope, and then makes a comparative study with the computational results based on Sarma method. It is proved that, the transfer coefficient method and the Sarma method have the basically same computational results during the matric suction's weakening, and the safety factor of the unsaturated soil slope gradually decreased. However, the transfer coefficient method has obvious limitations in the analysis of local sliding slope, while the Sarma method can be used in the slope stability problems in any shape of slip surface, which can determine the safety factor of the slope.

articleTitle: The Application of CAI Based on Expert Decision Support System (EDSS) in Youth Basketball Skill Training
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: With the development and progress of computer technology and information technology, computer is used to teach in various fields and the youth basketball skill training also use the CAI technology. In this paper, the R & D process and its significances of CAI in Youth basketball skill training with computer technology conduct the comprehensive analysis. In the end, put forward the principle of the CAI manufacture of youth basketball skill training.

articleTitle: Environment Space Design of Business Circle Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The business circle as a product of a new era of consumption, bearing the important task of city economic development and cultural accommodation. In the development of the new normal economic development trend, how to develop the third industry, not only related to the national economic development, but also related to people's livelihood. In the past, the design of the business district more is to consider the economic benefits, did not take into account the cultural factors of the values of the business district. This paper comprehensively considers the human factor and the economic model of the modern intelligent algorithm, we first through the SVM algorithm on the values of the classification of the business district design of the physical and chemical analysis, hoping to get the perfect design.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Clustered PV Systems Output Control
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The world's growing energy demand raises two challenges: climate change and energy security, and developing renewable energy has become common choice of the world to deal with the challenges. Solar energy is the largest available energy resource on earth so far, photovoltaic system has advantages of flexible installation, easy maintenance, environment friendly, so it receives attention of the world, and grid-connected PV generation system develops rapidly. Affected by solar radiation and other factors, power output of PV generation system is fluctuant and intermittent, network operation of large-scale PV generation system will affect the security, stability and economic operation of power system. The target of this paper is to solve key points such as restriction of PV system output.

articleTitle: Underwater Panoramic Image Mosaic Technology Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In the process of the research on the underwater panoramic image mosaic technology, as the current algorithm is used to carry out underwater panoramic image mosaic, it is difficult to resist the strong absorption and scattering characteristics of the water medium to light, it has the problem of imaging difficulties in underwater panoramic images. To this end, a new method based on the improved genetic algorithm is proposed for underwater panoramic image mosaic. In this method, the underwater image is enhanced by genetic algorithm firstly. The different sampling point's distance of image is sampled to form a hierarchical structure of Pyramid image, and the image is filtered by Gauss kernel function. The pixels of panoramic image sample are compared with 26 adjacent pixels. According to the feature points extracted from the image, the feature vector and its direction and amplitude are calculated, furthermore, based on this, the image matching and stitching are completed, on this basis, the use of weighted smoothing fusion method for underwater panoramic image after stitching is used to make effective integration. The simulation results show that the method of underwater panoramic image mosaic based on improved genetic algorithm has better quality and efficiency.

articleTitle: Vehicle Pedestrian Detection Algorithm Based on AdaBoost
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Pedestrian detection is a hot research topic in the fields of image processing and computer vision. It has a lot of important applications in intelligent transportation, human action analysis, robot development, video surveillance and so on. We propose a kind of feature extraction method for pedestrian detection, which is motivated by the good merits of the Local Binary Patterns (LBP). Cascade AdaBoost classifier is used to detect pedestrian. Experiment results show that the proposed pedestrian detection algorithm has a good performance.

articleTitle: Research on the Prediction of Gasoline Engine Air Intake Flow Based on the BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In order to improving the real-time of air-fuel ratio control system and accuracy of inlet flow measurement for gas line engine, this paper proposed chaotic time series BP neural network prediction model for engine's inlet flow. By using phase space reconstruction technique of inlet flow time series of refactoring, recovery system of the original chaotic. Using BP network to training and projections reconstructed data, to improve the inlet flow measurement accuracy, and thus improve the gasoline engine air-fuel ratio control system of the real-time and accuracy. Experimental simulation results show that the prediction model of Chaotic sequence BP neural network has higher prediction accuracy, and provides a new approach for accurate and timely test gasoline engine inlet flow.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment in Tunnel Portal Based on Fuzzy AHP Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This study proposes a new damage classification criterion to classify and quantify tunnel damage. The factors influencing damage of tunnels are studied and discussed, including ground level, excavation width, overburden depth, bias pressure, adverse geology, ground water, the technology level and management level of construction units. Risk assessment of tunnels is important for an effective disaster management plan. A risk-based assessment technique is proposed as a way to quantify the risk of tunnels. The efficacy of the proposed method is illustrated using data from the MaAnShan tunnel.

articleTitle: A Multivariate Decision-Making Mathematical Models Based on the Fuzzy Mathematics Theory and Comprehensive Coordination of Statistics for Evaluating the Quality of Physical Education
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The decision-making model is a model established for the management decision, that is, it is a mathematical model developed to aid the decision-making. With the development of operational research, some effective decision-making analysis methods such as linear rule, dynamic rule, game theory, queuing theory, savings and deposit model, scheduling model have appeared. The fuzzy mathematics theory and statistical theory have been used in this paper and the evaluation of the quality of Physical Education (PE) is taken as an example to develop the multivariate decision-making mathematical models and their standards and methods, and the application value of multivariate decision-making mathematical models has been clarified.

articleTitle: The Demand Analysis of Vocational Education in BaZhou Employment Structure Evolution
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Employment structure is a decisive factor in vocational education, in turn, vocational education directly promotes the employment growth. Therefore, the development strategy of vocational education should be determined based on the changing trend of labor employment structure. This paper researches the changing trend of BaZhou employment structure and its impact on vocational education. It emphasizes the development scale, development level and major establishment keep pace with the BaZhou employment structure, to make mutual promotion, reflect the educational advantages and features of Higher Vocational Colleges, and thus provide references to further solve the employment problem in BaZhou.

articleTitle: Battery Management System of Electric Vehicle Based on CAN
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: With the worsening of the environment and the increasing depletion of oil resources, electric vehicles are gradually concerned and favored by the market as a kind of transportation almost with non-pollution, low noise and high efficiency. As one of the four key technologies of electric vehicles, battery is an important factor affecting the development and promotion of electric vehicles. And the study of charge and discharge management of electric vehicle battery by CAN bus technology is of great significance to the development of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Establishment of the Mathematic Model of the Roughness of the ECMP-Processed Micro-hole Internal Surface
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In order to build the mathematic model between the roughness of the micro-hole internal surface and various influencing factors, this paper employs the response surface method for analysis and research, because the response surface method is the most frequently-used statistical method to solve multi-variable problems directly and comprehensively. Besides, it can reflect the interaction between various factors, and its analysis of the experimental data is more clear and reasonable. Box-Benhnken Design (BBD) is an experimental design plan commonly adopted by the response surface method. BBD is usually used for the analysis and evaluation of the nonlinearity between three to seven influencing factors and evaluation indexes. It can predict all the major effects and the bidirectional interaction effects. Compared with the orthogonal experiment, it features stronger randomness and complete experimental data. The relationship between the response value and the fitting factors obtained through the latter is also more reliable. Based on the above advantages, this paper adopts BBD as the experimental plan.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Reform and Practicality for PE Exam at BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Traditional sports theory exam divorced from reality, causing serious discrepancies of athletic ability and theoretical performance for student. From the respective of reform and practicality, using principal component analysis, the main component was extracted from five factors at the impact of PE exam. The results showed that improving students' ability to master the theory and developing creative thinking can be used as the main ingredient. Basing on BP neural network model, according to the actual situation, evaluation was conducted, and giving examples of evaluation.

articleTitle: Vernacular Architecture Landscape Protection Method Based on Three-Dimensional Panoramic Imaging Hybrid Technology
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Due to formal protection and commercial development, cultural ecology and cultural forms of vernacular architecture landscape that have local characteristics have been threatened seriously. However, at present the records of vernacular architecture landscape protection lack support of new and high technology. Three-dimensional panoramic hybrid technology can blend the virtual objects accurately into real environment through computer graphics and computer vision technology. This technique provides an effective way to express a stereoscopic three-dimensional real scene. In this research, three-dimensional panoramic hybrid technology is reasonably applied to implementation strategy and process of vernacular architecture landscape protection, which can make up the inadequacy of application field of vernacular architecture heritage protection, and can extend application of information technology based on 3-dimensional digitalization in architecture heritage protection at the same time.

articleTitle: Research on the Test System of the BLDC Motor Based on Virtual Instrument
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The brushless DC motor has been widely used in the automobile field because of its high comprehensive performance. In order to meet the requirements of the performance test of the brushless DC motor, aiming at the shortage of the traditional motor test, the motor torque speed test system based on virtual instrument is developed. The system uses the virtual instrument instead of the traditional instrument, the hardware circuit is replaced by the test software, and combined with the data acquisition card PCI-6221, to carry out data acquisition, processing and analysis of multiple channels of motor. Using Lab VIEW to write the motor torque speed measurement program and the PID control algorithm program, the on-line detection and high precision speed control of the brushless DC motor speed is realized. The results show that the system is reliable and stable, and the accuracy and convenience of the motor test are improved.

articleTitle: The Design Research of a Small Landscape Space in the Complex Function Mode
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: With tensions of land resources, comprehensive development of landscape space and space functions constantly gathering, it has an important value to research the complex function patterns of landscape space. Through the interdisciplinary research on complex function mode and landscape space, we analyze the feature of complex function mode of landscape space, and explore this design applications of complex function mode in a small landscape space. Combined with case studies, we propose a small landscape space design strategy in line with the composite function mode, and explain the design process of complex function mode in a small space landscape. It has a very important significance for us to enhance the landscape space inclusive and extend the life cycle.

articleTitle: Explore the Use of the Network and Mobile Terminal in Solving the Psychological Problem
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The application of the network and the intelligent terminal opens a new mode of medical treatment, in the diagnosis and treatment of mental disease, how to build a smart, efficient model is a major issue in front of scientific research. In this paper, the energy consumption of the mobile terminal is reduced based on the Q learning network and the wireless body area network routing method, improve the accuracy of data reception and the battery life. Dynamic data obtained by real-time data exchange, BP Adaboost strong classifier algorithm is used to accurately model the psychological problems of patients.

Author Keywords: intelligent terminal Q earning WBAN BP_Adaboost psychological problems

articleTitle: Vocational Education Modern Apprenticeship Development Strategy Research
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The modern apprenticeship is an innovative development model in vocational education in our country, it has a very profound cultural foundation and the practical. It originated in the long-term social practice activity, has very rich connotation, understand the current actual development environment in our country, for its use in the modern vocational education in our country has the very vital significance.

articleTitle: Seismic Damage of Nonstructural System in Space Structures
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The seismic (especially collapse) of structure and casualties were always paid more attention to after the earthquake. A great deal of manpower and resource have been invested to prevent the failure of structure under severe earthquakes, and the seismic performance of structure was improved obviously. In contrast, the seismic damage of nonstructural system (such as ceiling system) was also severe in the past severe earthquakes, which not only caused the direct economic loss and prevented the people to escape from building in the earthquake, but also influenced the emergency rescue and delayed the reconstruction after the earthquake. In addition, the investment in nonstructural system is always more than the structure in the modern building, especially for the space structure (such as airport terminal) with special function. And the losses caused by the function interruption of nonstructural system were more times than the value of the structure itself after the earthquake. And that the seismic damage not only caused economic loss, but also hampered the earthquake relief. For being used as emergency command center and the shelter, the space structure plays a very important role in earthquake relief and keeps operating normally in and after earthquake. Therefore, the seismic performance level of space structure is more important. Yet research on the seismic performance of nonstructural system in space structure has so far been little, and the standard and guideline is scarce. Besides, it is not clear that who is responsible for seismic performance of nonstructural system (structure engineer or nonstructural designer), and more attention should be paid on seismic performance of nonstructural system in space structure.

Author Keywords: nonstructural system space structures seismic damage

articleTitle: A Study on Key Techniques of Wisdom Campus Information Recommendation Platform Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This thesis employs the mainstream Hadoop framework to store and analyze the large-scale data generated in the campus environment. The system will first collect, process and save data by using the HDFS distributed file system. And then data mining and intelligent analysis of the data will be carried out. Last, the recommendation system framework which deals with large dataset will be put forward based on the above two steps. Therefore, a modified collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm based on the students' similarity will be achieved and the accuracy as well as the efficiency of recommendation will be improved.

articleTitle: Preliminary Study on Construction Technology of "Rain Garden"
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: With the speeding up of urbanization process, many cities facing a series of problems such as water shortage, water environment pollution and so on. The promotion and construction of rain garden will be one of the effective ways to alleviate this problem. In addition, the establishment of the rain garden brings new green space to the city, and provide residents with recreational environment at the same time, but also promote the recycling of water resources. This paper discusses the rain garden concept, the practical significance, the way and the way of the construction technology, and the basic requirements of the construction technology, and summarizes the applicable of the rainwater garden plants in Beijing area, and discusses the development trend of the rain garden. In order to provide reference and guidance for the construction of rainwater garden system in urban construction of our country.

articleTitle: Rain Landscape Strategies Based on the Green Stormwater Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Green storm water infrastructure is of great significance to alleviate urban water logging and build healthy urban water cycle. Traditional storm water infrastructure is not a good solution to the problem of urban flooding, contrary causes more serious consequences. When the green storm water infrastructure is used to build urban rainwater recycling system, it should be combined with the landscape, highlighting its aesthetics, ecology, culture. Combined with outstanding cases at home and abroad, the paper analyzes the rain gardens, green streets, ecological park these three typical green storm water infrastructure, and sums up the landscape policy of green storm water infrastructure in order to provide reference for 'sponge city'.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Employment Education Online Platform for College Students
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: To break down major barriers, this paper sets employment as orientation, summarizes key technology field from post group and divides key technology field into key technology module. Then, key technology module is further divided into key technology points to form the whole technology knowledge system to be embedded into system to realize resources sharing. An online teaching platform which faces employment education is further proposed. The functions and framework of platform are put forward according to business model. Meanwhile, online teaching and aided teaching module are designed and realized to present operation of networked teaching platform with specific application samples. Results show that platform combines teaching with management to improve teachers' creativity to the largest extent. Meanwhile, it also improves students' professional attainment as well as professional ability and reduces difference from learning in school and working in company.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Teaching Resource Platform under Flash Stream Media On-Demand Mode
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper propose a novel resource platform construction scheme based on multimedia network teaching system. The research focuses on standardized resource construction supporting Flash in the teaching system, including text, graphics, videos, animations and multimedia courseware, multimedia release, and upload, download and management of relative files. The system is integrated with multimedia technologies to choose flash stream media technology that has platform independence and higher playing efficiency. It is implemented to the construction of resource library to be important part of the system, which makes it possible to be online study and real-time resource using for learners, to improve the utilization efficiency of multimedia resources.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Heavy Truck EPS System
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: A fuzzy control based on particle swarm optimization of heavy truck EPS system control strategy is proposed, on the basis of vehicle EPS system overall design, combined with the driver steering subjective feeling and the sense of road requirements designed assistance characteristics curve, steering system model, 7 degrees of freedom vehicle dynamics model. The simulation experimental results show that compared with the conventional fuzzy control, this method can improve the whole dynamic response of heavy truck EPS system efficiently.

articleTitle: Software Project Management Based on Struts Architecture
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Based on the theory of process improvement of software engineering, software project management system based on Struts structure is proposed. The system requirement analysis is given and the whole process of project management is analyzed. The designed software project management system includes human resource management, scheduling and task management, risk management, cost management, quality management and knowledge base management. By means of testing software project management system and network equipment, it can be seen that the performance of this system is stable and reliable. Besides, it is simple to use and can be put into practical use.

articleTitle: Adaptability Analysis of System for Retail Chain Enterprise Management
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The ability to improve the information transmission is not the advantage of food retail chain enterprise information management system, how to ensure the quality of food retail chain enterprises have become the focus of today. Based on this, in this paper, the methods of questionnaire and mathematical statistics, food retail chain enterprise information management system of our country are discussed in this paper, the questionnaire covered most provinces of China 50 retail food chain, in view of the enterprise informationization construction condition and the security of food quality management research. Results show that more than half of the enterprises will choose ERP system, mainly on information collection processing has obvious advantages. But the quality of management with serious defects. To the retail chain enterprise should strengthen the system in the future on the quality of management ability, so as to better adapt to the demand of the market.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Embedded Wireless Gateway
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper analyses the wireless sensor grid architecture which can't meet the current requirements that the monitoring systems need to be easily deployed and maintained, to keep high stability and strong reliability in the dangerous environment, such as tunnel and caverns. Directed at these problems, an optimized grid architecture was developed. The paper introduces the advantages of the new architecture, and discusses the security strategies of the architecture from data collecting and forwarding, provides the designing schemes of the key node which is embedded in the wireless gateway both in hardware and software. The architecture with high security, flexible structure and strong scalaility characteristics can be applied widely in other security monitoring and control fields.

articleTitle: The Geographic Environment Analysis of Regional Economic Development of Yunnan Province of China Based on the Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper uses the analysis methods of data mining, data quality and management, semantic engine and prediction in big data to analyze the geographic environment of the Yunnan's economic development from its special location and geographic elements, beholding that the geographic elements lay basic material conditions for its economic development of Yunnan province. Geographic factors on one hand encourage the economic development and on the other hand affect together the economic development of Yunnan province.

articleTitle: The LPV Method for Estimating the Power Battery Based on Hysteresis Coupled Model and Power Conversion
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Battery SOC has different value caused by different battery rated capacity under different charge-discharged rate. In view of the national standard using C/3 discharged rate to define battery rated capacity, this article proposes that charging and discharging capacity in different current should be unified to C/3 discharging capacity through the power conversion coefficient. Meanwhile, the battery hysteresis characteristics have a great impact on the battery model. This paper consider these two factors, establish battery equivalent circuit model, and embed model parameter identification to LPV-Kalman model. Experiment shows that, this SOC estimation method has higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Clustering Research Based on Intelligent Computing
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: FCM is sensitive to initialization and tends to result in local minimum in iterations. This paper studies the crossover and mutation probability of genetic algorithm and presents a new crossover and mutation probability. The proposed clustering scheme based on genetic algorithm and fuzzy c-means takes full advantage of the global optimization of genetic algorithm and the local search ability of FCM. The experiment results show that the proposed scheme has higher accuracy than traditional scheme.

articleTitle: Heavy Truck EPS System Simulation Based on PSO Optimization Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Based on particle swarm optimization of heavy truck EPS system control strategy is proposed, on the basis of vehicle EPS system overall design, taking DC motor current as the control target, using particle swarm optimization fuzzy control strategy, using MATLAB/Simulink as simulation platform, taking dump truck as research type models and commercial vehicle simulation model which equipped with EPS system is established. The simulation experimental results show that compared with the conventional fuzzy control, particle swarm optimization fuzzy control can improve the whole dynamic response of heavy truck EPS system efficiently, also good steering portability and handling stability is obtained.

articleTitle: Size Effect of Core Samples on Bridge Concrete Strength with Drilled Core Method
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Based on the comparison of experiment and field testing, we investigate the influence of the samples size on the concrete compressive strength with drilled core method. For this purpose a lot of core specimens having height-diameter ratios of 0.5, 0.7, 1.0, 1.2 and diameters of 50mm, 70mm, and 100mm were casted in concrete laboratory and in field. The relationship of concrete compressive strength between the different height-diameter ratios and the different diameters is determined. The modified relationship between the small diameter core sample and the concrete strength standard test block of bridge engineering is established. And the linear regression analyses exhibited better performance.

articleTitle: Spectrum Analysis of Ship Radiated Noise Simulation Signal Based on EMD-LMS
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Mainly adopting adaptive filtering algorithm which is based on EMD-LMS, this paper made spectral analysis of the filtered signal by simulation experiment and then compared it with the classical spectral analysis method and wavelet de-noising method. It verified the validity and superiority of the spectral analysis method based on EMD-LMS. The experimental results show that the method adopted in this paper has better resolution to spectrum analysis of Ship radiated noise simulation signal. By using adaptive filtering techniques combined by EMD and least mean square (LMS), make a spectrum analysis of period gram method and autocorrelation method to filtered signal. Compared it with the classical spectral analysis method and wavelet de-noising method, and then we get the spectrum analysis of ship radiated noise simulation signal based on EMD-LMS.

articleTitle: The Internet of Things the Design and Implementation of Smart Home Control System
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In this paper, based on the new development of smart home - the Internet of things smart home control system a corresponding, this paper from the Internet of things smart home control system design and implementation of several angles in this, in-depth analysis of the operation principle of home control system.

articleTitle: The Model and Evaluation of Ecological Stoichiometry Characteristics of Different Forest Types
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The nitrogen and phosphorus characteristics of plants represent plant features and environmental factors. This paper tries to distinguish leaf and litter C: N: P stoichiometric characteristics, trees' nitrogen and phosphorus restoration, and the relationship between C, N content and temperature and precipitation. Based on the above content, this paper is divided into three parts. Part one discusses the study materials and methods, and showing the main species of trees and their life forms in tabular form. The second part is the most important section, this section introduces ecological stoichiometry characteristics of different forest types. The last part is the final summary of the conclusions of this paper.

articleTitle: Research of BS Development Platform PanBSP Based on Conglomerate Corporate Business System Development Needs
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: BS development platform PanBSP is a BS software development platform exclusively designed for conglomerate business management. Adopting J2EE standard structure, JSON and XML interactive data packet format, with intensified stability, dependability and usability, PanBSP has a very strong capability of system development for conglomerate corporate business. Business integration platform PanBIS is used for connecting with disparate systems with standard structure of ESB and XML data packet format.

articleTitle: Identification and Analysis of SH Wave Detection Signal for Pipeline Coating Based on HHT
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper introduces a new signal processing method for the detection signal of pipeline coating. There are. Aiming at peeling, holes and others defects in the oil and gas pipeline coating, this paper uses the SH guided wave transducer of separation type of the transmitter and receiver to detect these defects. The energy spectrum is obtained by the HHT method, and there are comparative analysis between the dispersion characteristics of the theoretical analysis and energy spectrum by simulation calculation. Analysis results show that, it is feasible to detect the bonding state of the coating on the surface of the steel plate with the dispersion property of SH modes. Many of IMF components have a more obvious fluctuation characteristic in the detection signal of the pipeline coating unit based on HHT, and it is sensitive to the information of the frequency domain. The energy spectrum distribution in the HHT is reflected in the pipeline coating. And therefore r the method is effective in the detection and identification of the stripping of the pipeline coating.

articleTitle: Standard System of ESP Teachers under the Multi-level Decision-Making Model
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Based on the criteria for ESP teachers, this paper considers the four main aspects of ESP Teacher Standards System, ESP teaching profession System, ESP teachers' self-development and standard scope and ESP teachers. Multi-level decision making model based around the standard system ESP teachers, establish four factors set under the decision indicators from the system environment, comprehensive training system and teacher capacity building standard positioning system.

articleTitle: An Intelligent and Personalized Tobacco Brand Recommendation Method
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This paper aims to solve the intelligent and personalized tobacco brand recommendation problem, which greatly affects the sales performance of tobacco enterprises. Firstly, we discuss how to mine the internal correlations between different users to compute user similarity. Particularly, we estimate user similarity by constructing user feature vectors using Cosine distance. Secondly, a novel intelligent and personalized tobacco brand recommendation algorithm is given, and the top ranked tobacco brands are output as the tobacco brand recommendation results. Finally, experiments test the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm by two main aspects, and positive results are achieved.

articleTitle: Research and Improvement of Perturbation and Observation Method in Photovoltaic Power System
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of photovoltaic array, which need maximum tracing power. Perturbation and observation method has become one of the algorithm of the wide range research because of its simple and easy. But the traditional P&O will be oscillation in near the maximum power point due to its fixed step disturbance and leads to some loss of power and in certain circumstances and incorrect judgment will be in steady state. In order to overcome these shortcomings, a variety of improved methods are proposed, and the main improvements of those are summarized. Some simulation experiments have been done for these methods, and these methods are proved to be feasible.

articleTitle: Distributed Task Scheduling Algorithm Based on Intelligent Computing
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Intelligent optimization algorithms are a class of bionic algorithms and are well characterized by its self-organizing, self-learning, self-adaptive, implicit parallelism and guided search, etc. These algorithms have the preponderance over solving complex issues and have been widely used in engineering technology, nonlinear optimization, structural design, parallel computing, social science as well as many other fields. Based on improved ant colony algorithm, this paper studies task matching and scheduling for parallel computing. The experiment results show that the performance of proposed task scheduling algorithm is better than traditional ant colony algorithm.

articleTitle: Research of Suitability Indicators on Ground-Source Heat Pump in Hot Summer and Cold Winter Area
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: This article related to ground-source heat pump system in recent years suitability evaluation indexes of journal articles are summarized. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of different criteria layer, factor index layer, from the perspective of qualitative and quantitative analysis of each evaluation indexes on influence of ground-source heat pump systems, and combine with hydro geological conditions of hot summer and cold winter area. Eventually determine the hot summer and cold winter region suitability evaluation index of ground-source heat pump system.

articleTitle: Integrated Ramp Metering and Mainstream Traffic Flow Control on Multi-lane Roadways
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Traffic congestion on multi-lane roadway has been a global issue recently. Numerous control strategies have been proposed to mitigate the traffic congestion. This paper introduced an improved control model that integrated both ramp and mainstream on multi-lane roadways. The basic model proposed by Papageorgiou was firstly introduced, and then the improved control model taking both ramp and mainstream into consideration was modified. The simulation experiments were conducted to investigate the effect of the improved model. Results indicate that compared to no control and ALINEA model, the modified model proposed by this study has the best control effect on multi-lane roadway congestion mitigation.

articleTitle: Study on Capacity of Foundation of Digital Media Design Expertise Based on Analytic Hierarchy Model
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In this paper, study digital media design professional basic capabilities, based on hierarchy analytic model, through investigation and analysis, combined with the characteristics of digital media design professionals, to get the professional basic capabilities include Digital Media product design and development capabilities, artistic accomplishment (Digital Media Works appreciation), professional development capacity. Develop these capabilities in the professional teaching, mainly in learning ability, teamwork, innovation and market awareness and practical ability. By solving the weight vector to obtain weights three main basic abilities by determining weights, a comparative analysis of the construction of the distribution of digital media design expertise in basic capabilities and Training System.

articleTitle: Study on Non-uniform Bed Load Random Motion
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In natural river sediment particles movement is of a great deal of randomness, and which is always the focus of the scholars at home and abroad, and is also the research difficulty. The non-uniform sediment flume experiment over rough bed was conducted in this study, the movement process of the non-uniform bed load particles over rough bed was observed with the camera, the parameters such as the motion distance, motion velocity and motion/rest time of bed load particles in the observation period were obtained and analyzed, finally the random motion of bed load particles was studied.

articleTitle: Analysis and Simulation of Micro-grid Islanding Detection
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Micro-grid is a kind of new organization and structure of distributed energy, It integrates the advantages of distributed generation and weakens the adverse impact of the distributed generation on the grid. It makes the distributed power generation units, power grid and the end users to be connected as a whole, so the structure and configuration can be optimized easily. At the same time, the operation of micro-grid can improve energy efficiency, reduce the effect of energy power systems on the environment, solve the serious problems of lacking of energy, lead the use of energy to green and environmental protection.

articleTitle: Discussion of the Big Data Application on Forest By-Products Transportation
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Annually, numbers of costs were spent in the forest by-products transportation in our country. However, it remains to be a question how to apply new technology in saving costs. Nowadays, with the development of the Internet Technology, large data storage capacity is easy to assess. But what we need to emphasize most is how to obtain and use the big data, This provides a platform which enables us to discuss how to apply this into the forest by-products transportation. It will help save costs as well as improve efficiency when the analysis of big data being used in that.

articleTitle: Dynamic Artificial-Immune-System Models of Default Detection for Sensing Networks
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Models analyzing a signaling mechanism in Artificial Immune System (AIS) could be expanded with advance of sensing networks. In principle, if a sensing network has enough nodes linked to propagate signals, it could be viewed as a continuous field, and be analyzed by field analysis methodology, meanwhile, it could be analyzed by random and probability methodology for that its nodes are also discrete. The two kinds of methodology should be applied to describe key characteristics of AIS, which is self-adaptation taking the forms of stability, immunity, and repellency. The paper proposes some models of the two kinds of methodology.

articleTitle: Applicability Research of Computer Network Technology in Supply Chain Logistics under the AHP
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The rapid development of computer networks, the time of the entire logistics process substantially reduced, and reduced logistics costs. For practical research in computer network technology in supply chain logistics, this article as a starting point of four indicators, namely computer network technology in the construction of logistics information, the positive role of computer network technology logistics information technology, computer network technology in modern logistics application trends, improve the level of information logistics business logistics enterprises start to actively promote weight logistics enterprise information management.

articleTitle: Dynamic O2O Resources Clustering Method Study
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: O2O is becoming popular in recent years. O2O encourages online selling and offline serving. A customer values a product or service by his/her habit or prefer. This action is affected by different factors. Customers take care for these factors differcently, but the core is to hope a better over all servicing experiences. This paper proposed a dynamic O2O resources clustering method. The proposed method is utilized into clothing market modeling, and 6 key factors were found via this model. Analysis show that the model has directed a right conclusion to the current O2O application in clothing market.

articleTitle: The Research of the Key Issues of Innovation Based on BT Transaction Mode in Urban Rail Traffic
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: BT-Mode is a financing mode that the government using nongovernmental funds for the construction of infrastructure. It has greatly reduced the financial pressure of government because of BT-Mode does not contain operation period, the repurchase price is composed of construction cost and investment cost. If the construction investment is out of control, the repurchase price is inevitably on the high side, which would result in a risk of repurchase. On the basis of summarizing the material in the implementation of Shenzhen Metro Line M, this paper adopts the grounded theory research method to identify three core elements of investment control on project contractor level. The three core elements include project control right allocation, risk - sharing in the contract and control of repurchase total price. The research provides an important decision-making guideline for the project investment control of public sectors.

articleTitle: The Study of the Value of Ancient Education Philosophy Embodied in Contemporary Based on Fuzzy Analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Ancient Chinese philosophy of education for the contemporary educational experience left a good education, moral support for the contemporary social development, improve the overall quality of contemporary human society, it is to build a theoretical root harmonious society, ancient educational philosophy to the contemporary universal and particularity of unity, play a leading role in education seriously. Fuzzy Analysis Based on ancient philosophy of education in contemporary manifestation evaluated.

articleTitle: Research on Complicated Background Suppression of Infrared Image Based on Vision Perception Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Aimed at the characteristics of infrared images for moving target, such as complicated background, low signal-to-noise ratio and low contrast, a new method for complicated background suppression is proposed based on Large Field (LF) and Small Field (SF) system in the paper. Firstly, the CCD sensors are used to obtain infrared video data for moving target. Then, after analyzing the visual motion detection mechanism of insect compound eye, the paper establishes background suppression model based on LF&SF. In this model, LF is used to suppress noise of edge detection while SF is used to do nonlinear enhancement of target features and estimation of target movement direction. Finally, the paper uses the primary motion detector to integrate LF with SF. Real scene experiment shows that this proposed method has obvious advantages in suppressing the cloud cover, grass lands and other noise and enhancing target.

articleTitle: Research on Incentive Mechanism in Logistics Provider's Service Quality Improvement
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Incentive mechanism for logistics service provider's service quality improvement is studied. First, we design a revenue sharing contract to promote logistics provider quality improved behavior. The effect of the contract without counting the opportunism behavior is analyzed. The results show that the contract can encourage logistics provider to improve logistics service quality. Second, in view of logistics provider's opportunistic behavior, we established an evolution model combining reward and punishment using the evolutionary game theory. The results show that only combining reward and punishment, the mechanism can play a good incentive effect. Finally, on the basis of the above research, some advices on the logistics services integrator cooperation with logistics provider are given.

articleTitle: Study on the Layout of Urban River Management Based on the Consideration of Local Situation and Topography
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: With the sustained and stable development of China's economy, the large-scale construction and development of urbanization, the urban river has been greatly influenced by the stress and the loss of the inherent ecological resilience and vitality. The restoration of urban rivers has become common understanding of society and focus of attention. In Guangzhou, China, a typical urban river management as an example, focusing on urban river water environment to improve governance is put forward. In management, combined with the local situation and topography, rain and sewage shunt, interception, dredging, rainwater collection and treatment, river ecological control project design measures are corresponding proposed, to effectively solve the local river water quality problem.

articleTitle: Army Tactical Information System Software Framework Based on SOA Design
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: In order to establish effective real-time tactical information integration and sharing system proposed framework Army tactical information system software based on service-oriented, and focused description of the software framework consisting of two important messaging middleware and content services operating environment. Software framework to effectively promote the efficient integration of the various battlefields information systems, rapid and effective transfer of tactical information, reducing the human intervention factor message transmission intermediate process, thereby speeding up the response time of each military systems, improved battlefield survivability.

articleTitle: Based on Micro-grid Small-Signal Model Grid Off-Grid Seamless Handover Stability Study
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: Micro switch seamlessly from the power grid network is an important means to ensure the micro grid load within a continuous and reliable power supply. Respectively, micro power grid and off grid state to establish small-signal model, using eigen value analysis, analysis of micro-grid system stability, the stability of the two states before and after the micro-grid simulation contrast, obtained the switching process will produce sustained oscillation, and the question of how to optimize the controller decreases the impact of the program oscillations.

articleTitle: Dynamic Response of the Single-Layer Kiewitt-8 Reticulated Dome Subjected to the Airplane Crash
publicationTitle: 2015 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data and Smart City
abstract: The dynamic response of large space structures under accidental impact has been the subject of intense research since the occurrence of the 9/11 incident. In the present paper, events of aircraft impact to the single-layer kiewitt-8 reticulated dome were simulated by using the 3D ANSYS/LS-DYNA. Impact loadings were carried out respectively by the Riera force history method and by modeling a real plane similar to Bombardier Challenger 850. Simulation results indicated that the impact by modeling a real plane directly is more reasonable than the method by Riera force history. Furthermore, a series of different impact events were added to investigate the effect of impacting position and the flight attitude of the airplane.

Author Keywords: Finite element model of a small airplane
